jobs.title: Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job title
: Security Project Manager (SPM)
Reports to
: Regional Security Manager (RSM) – ANZ
Location
: Melbourne, Australia (Remote)

Mandatory Requirement:
NV1 clearance required for the role (Must Have)

About our team

We are a dynamic, dedicated team that provides management and support for a global guarding services account that spans across 30+ countries. Our client is an industry-leading datacenter organization, and we pride ourselves on delivering best-in-class solutions through our teams made up of Security Operations, Shared Services, Threat and Incident Management, Environmental Health and Safety, and Human Resources. As part of this team, you'll work alongside a group of professionals committed to excellence and innovation.

About the role

The Security Project Manager is responsible for leading the implementation, testing, commissioning, and delivery of physical security systems supporting our large, complex, global client that involves critical infrastructure portfolio across the APAC region. This role manages high-profile and business-critical projects involving access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarm systems, radio communications, and other physical security technologies across datacenters, leased colocation facilities, and other critical infrastructure environments.

Working across multiple concurrent projects, the Security Project Manager partners with architects, engineers, construction managers, security vendors, and client stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered in accordance with established standards, timelines, budgets, and operational requirements. The role requires strong project management skills, a solid technical understanding of physical security systems, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams while delivering consistent project outcomes.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will lead the implementation, testing, commissioning, and deployment of physical security systems, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with established security standards. You will review security designs and project documentation, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure consistency, compliance, cost efficiency, and quality throughout the project lifecycle.

You will oversee multiple security projects across the APAC region, supporting project planning, scheduling, budgeting, reporting, and performance tracking while collaborating closely with architects, engineers, construction teams, vendors, and client representatives. You will drive continuous improvement initiatives through process optimisation, automation, reporting, and data-driven decision-making to enhance the efficiency, scalability, and maturity of the physical security program.

You will act as a trusted advisor to internal and external stakeholders, support incident response activities, represent the client's physical security program, and contribute to strategic initiatives that improve operational performance. You will also maintain strict confidentiality, ensure stakeholder requirements are effectively managed, and support additional projects, reporting requirements, and leadership priorities as required.

What you need to apply

To be successful in this role, you should possess a bachelor's degree in business, security, engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of project or construction management experience, including at least three years managing the deployment of physical security systems or security engineering solutions. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will also be considered.

You should have strong knowledge of physical security technologies, including access control, intrusion detection, alarm monitoring, and video surveillance systems, along with experience implementing and supporting physical security systems throughout construction project lifecycles. Experience working within datacenters or other critical infrastructure environments is highly desirable.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is required, and professional certifications such as PSP, CPP, PMP, or CSPM are preferred. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing business requirements, and confidently present to customers, senior leaders, and executive audiences.

NV1 clearance required for the role (Must Have)

What you’ll get

We offer more than just a job; we offer the opportunity to contribute to one of the world's most advanced and innovative physical security programs supporting critical infrastructure on a global scale.

You will work alongside experienced security professionals, engineers, and operational leaders while gaining exposure to large-scale security initiatives across multiple countries and business functions. This role provides opportunities for professional growth, cross-functional collaboration, and involvement in strategic projects that directly influence the future of physical security operations within a global technology environment.

The extra stuff

Candidates must be at least 18 years of age and possess the legal right to work in Australia.

A valid passport, or the ability to obtain one, is required. Travel may be required domestically and internationally for approximately 25% of the time, occasionally with limited notice.
Evening or weekend work may also be required during emergencies, critical incidents, or high-priority events.

Candidates must be willing to participate in the company's pre-employment screening process, including background investigations and drug screening where applicable.

The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, handle sensitive and confidential information, and work effectively in a fast-paced, 24/7 security environment. Regular computer use, data analysis, and report preparation are expected. Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds may be required, along with the ability to travel between project locations.

jobs.title: Legal Assistant / Project Manager - Remote
jobs.description:
PROJECT MANAGER — CLIENT OPERATIONS

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Immigration Law Firm

This role requires two strengths that do not always appear together: the discipline to keep complex client matters organized and the judgment to communicate clearly when information is incomplete, a deadline is approaching, or a client is concerned.

ABOUT CALDERARO LAW GROUP
Based in Miami, Florida, Calderaro Law Group is a U.S. immigration law firm that has supported hundreds of companies, investors, professionals, skilled workers, and families navigating complex immigration processes.
Our work affects important decisions in our clients’ lives and businesses. Clients need accurate work, reliable systems, and clear communication about what is happening, what is needed from them, and what comes next.

THE ROLE
The Project Manager will work closely with our Case Managers, leadership, service team, and collections team to maintain visibility and momentum across multiple client matters.
This person will not simply identify problems. They will clarify what happened, determine the appropriate next action, communicate with the people involved, and follow through until the issue is resolved.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Monitor assignments, deliverables, dependencies, and internal deadlines across multiple client matters.
Maintain accurate client records, reports, trackers, and account information.
Conduct regular audits and identify missing, inconsistent, or outdated information.
Prepare, review, organize, and distribute client documents and reports.
Schedule client meetings and confirm that the required people, documents, and information are available beforehand.
Keep clients proactively informed about the status of their matters, outstanding requirements, and upcoming steps.
Respond to client questions with clarity, professionalism, and empathy, especially when the answer requires additional verification.
Distinguish confirmed information from matters still being reviewed, avoid speculation, and escalate legal questions to the appropriate legal professional.
Coordinate with the service and collections teams when information or follow-up is required.
Identify stalled work, conflicting information, and process gaps before they affect deadlines or the client experience.
Raise problems together with a proposed next action whenever possible.
Help improve workflows as the firm continues to grow.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Internal records are complete, current, and reliable.
Clients understand where their matter stands, what is needed from them, and what will happen next.
Risks and inconsistencies are identified early and escalated appropriately.
Meetings begin with the necessary information and materials available.
Questions and commitments receive follow-up and are not allowed to disappear between teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Professional fluency in spoken and written English.
Professional fluency in at least one additional language. Spanish, Portuguese, or Mandarin is preferred.
College degree required.
Experience coordinating projects, documents, clients, deadlines, or operational workflows.
Experience communicating with clients in a professional, time-sensitive, or high-stakes environment.
Ability to write clear, concise, and professional client communications.
Ability to work independently and maintain reliable systems in a remote environment.
Experience in legal or professional services is preferred. Legal education is an advantage but is not required.

HOW TO APPLY
Email your application to Operations@VisaMiami.com.

Use this subject line:
Project Manager | Your Full Name | Your Second Language
Attach your résumé as a PDF named:
LastName_FirstName_PM.pdf
In the body of your email, respond to the following situation in no more than 200 words:
You begin your workday and discover:
A client meeting is scheduled for 10:00 a.m., but two required documents have not been received.
A client report due at noon contains a date that does not match the internal case record.
A client has asked why a recent payment is not yet reflected in their account.
A Case Manager needs help scheduling a time-sensitive meeting.
The internal tracker for another matter has not been updated for three business days.

Tell us:
What you would address first, second, and third—and why.
How you would ensure the remaining items are not overlooked.
The exact message, in no more than three sentences, that you would send to the client asking about the payment.

Do not assume or invent facts that are not provided.

At the end of your email, include your current city, time zone, and earliest available start date.
Candidates selected for the next stage will be contacted within three business days of applying.

We look forward to learning how you approach the work!

DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center.

The Role

This individual will be a pivotal member of our implementation team, leading complex integrations for new business and supporting re-implementations across our SMB and Enterprise segments. The Senior Implementation Manager will be responsible for managing the entire implementation lifecycle — from pre-sales support through post-launch handoff.

Our team embraces modern tooling and AI-assisted workflows to deliver smarter, faster implementations — and we’re looking for someone who is naturally curious about emerging technology and excited to use it as a force multiplier in their day-to-day work.

Success in this role will rely on a combination of strong client and project management skills, technical proficiency, executive presence, and the ability to manage the details while seeing the bigger picture. We are looking for an out-of-the-box thinker who can execute a high volume of projects.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Silicon Quantum Computing (SQC) is at the forefront of global efforts to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer, while delivering quantum-enhanced AI and simulation products to customers today.

Backed by over 25 years of technological excellence, SQC is a full-stack quantum computing company that leverages its proprietary manufacturing process to engineer atomic qubits in silicon with 0.13 nanometer precision. It is the most precise semiconductor manufacturing in the world, enabling systems with world-leading algorithmic fidelity, and a decisive advantage in the global quantum computing race.

Our products are commercially deployed and generating revenue. Watermelon, our quantum-enhanced AI system, is delivering superior results on real-world problems across energy, telecom and finance. Quantum Twins, our simulation platform, provides unparalleled ability to model quantum systems, accelerating molecule and materials discovery.

This is SQC: building the future of computing while delivering quantum impact today.

About The Role

SQC builds gate-based quantum computers in silicon. Our largest programmes are multi-year commitments to US government sponsors, delivered against fixed benchmarks, milestones and independent evaluation. We are hiring a Technical Project Manager into Projects, the team that plans and delivers those programmes.

You will own the detailed schedule end to end, across hardware tasks, software workstreams and partner deliverables, not just the high-level roadmap. That means holding a critical path that runs through fabrication, measurement, engineering and external subcontractors, and running structured risk assessment as a standing discipline rather than an occasional exercise. Predictability is the core of the job. You will flag early that a milestone is at risk of slipping rather than surfacing it after the fact, and when new information or a blocker lands, you will adjust the plan quickly and make the consequences clear to the people who need to act on them.

You will own the commercial side of the programme too: the budget, tracked against the annual projections we hold with our investors, with variances flagged early and visible to management, alongside funding proposals and the subcontractors delivering into the programme. You will own the government interface, including the independent verification and validation relationship, keeping internal schedules aligned to sponsor milestones and holding the programme accountable to the exit criteria it will be judged against. You will also support our quantum machine learning customer interface, keeping programme schedules and customer commitments aligned, keeping QML customers informed of deliverable timelines and test results as they feed into the programme, and escalating commercial priorities or scope changes rather than absorbing them into the plan.

Based at our Sydney facility, you will work across nearly every team in the business, moving between technical detail with engineers, clear synthesis for management, and concise updates for the executive and the CEO. This is a role for someone with a genuine project management mindset: structured, disciplined about following defined processes rather than improvising case by case, personally committed to milestones, and comfortable challenging engineering estimates, holding teams to their commitments and pushing back when delivery slips.

Role Responsibilities

Own the detailed delivery schedule across multiple workstreams, covering hardware tasks alongside software and partner deliverables
Build and maintain a credible critical path, and keep multi-team work moving transparently and to a high technical bar
Run structured risk assessment as a recurring responsibility, identifying dependencies early and maintaining mitigation plans against them
Flag milestone risk before it materialises, then replan and communicate the consequences as soon as a blocker or new information emerges
Hold teams accountable to their commitments, challenge engineering estimates and priorities, and escalate where delivery is slipping
Own the government interface, including the independent verification and validation (IV&V) relationship, planning test and evaluation against exit criteria and packaging results into the reporting and reviews sponsors expect
Own and track the programme budget, maintaining alignment between actual spend and the annual projections agreed with our investors, and flagging variances early
Develop funding proposals and manage subcontractors, including statements of work, deliverables, commercial terms and spend against plan

Experience owning a programme budget, tracking spend against plan and reporting variance

About SQC

SQC was founded by renowned physicist and materials scientist Michelle Simmons, who pioneered the field of atomic electronics, including the development of the world’s first single-atom transistor and the first integrated circuit built with atomic precision. Our Chair, Simon Segars, former CEO of Arm, is a leader in the semiconductor industry and was instrumental in developing the processors that powered the mobile computing revolution.

We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. The Maryland State Department of Education is dedicated to supporting a world-class educational system that prepares all students for college and career success in the 21st century. This position provides leadership and technical expertise to support the development and implementation of statewide assessments for grades prekindergarten through high school. The position provides facilitation and coordination of Maryland State Department of Education (MSDE) staff, the staff of contractors, and the staff of local education agencies (LEAs) responsible for implementation of online testing in schools throughout the state. This position also assists with the training and monitoring of the LEA 24-Special Placement Schools.

Communicate with LEA24 executive and education directors regarding MSDE updates, revisions, and requirements related to the administration of statewide assessments.

Mission Summary:

The Motional Technical Program Management team is seeking a talented TPM to support our release pipeline. This role requires strong collaboration and management across our autonomy integration, software, hardware, operations, and testing teams. We are currently seeking an individual who has strong skills in cross-functional work, quick decision making, and execution of release activities and planning to ensure that we continuously iterate and improve. Join us at the forefront of autonomous driving technology!

What You'll Do:

Drive alignment across stakeholder teams to track planned software and hardware releases.
Actively manage execution of release activities, tracking progress against key release metrics, such as deployment cadence, release stability, or defect leakage rates and removing blockers and inefficiencies as required.
Partner with cross-functional teams to configure and improve our targeted configurations end-to-end.
Establish and maintain comprehensive release calendars, notes, and documentation to ensure transparent communication across engineering and executive stakeholders, working through technical details while conducting performance reviews and retrospectives.
Set priorities and coordinate between multiple engineering and operations teams and external stakeholders to support our overall release strategy and deconflict activities and resources.
Work closely with engineering leadership to help define and track key organizational objectives.
Proactively identify, manage, and report on risks and issues.

What We're Looking For:

Demonstrated experience with Continuous Integration and automated SW testing.
Demonstrated experience in managing FW, SW, and HW configurations.
Minimum of 5 years experience working with complex systems, including but not limited to, autonomous vehicles, ADAS, robotics, etc.
Demonstrated experience working across teams and disciplines resolving competing priorities and managing dependencies.
Creative problem solver, resourceful and skilled at conflict resolution.
Strong written and oral communication skills, especially the ability to communicate complex engineering issues and tailor messaging based on audience.

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

What will your typical day look like?

Manage delivery across a portfolio of concurrent software, automation, data and AI initiatives, coordinating plans, priorities, dependencies, resources and milestones across the team.
Establish and run a consistent delivery cadence from intake and design through build, quality review, deployment, adoption and ongoing measurement.
Partner with Product Owners and Technical Leads to translate priorities into executable plans, resolve cross-team dependencies and proactively manage delivery risks, issues and decisions.
Guide solutions through required technology governance, architecture, security, privacy, risk and compliance processes, ensuring required reviews and artifacts are incorporated into delivery.
Maintain clear visibility into portfolio status, capacity, commitments and delivered value; provide concise reporting to leadership and continuously improve the team's delivery practices and ways of working

About The Team

AIDA (AI, Data & Analytics) builds technology solutions that transform how Audit & Assurance work gets done. We combine modern software engineering, AI and automation to create tools that simplify complex processes, reduce manual effort and enable teams to work more efficiently and effectively. Our solutions range from purpose-built applications and workflow automation to generative and agentic AI experiences that integrate with enterprise data and systems. We are looking for a senior project management leader who can bring structure, discipline and transparency to how these solutions move from idea to production — coordinating across business and technical teams and helping establish a scalable delivery model for the AIDA portfolio

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

You are someone with these required skills, experience & qualifications:

10+ years of project, program or technology delivery experience, with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional technology initiatives and multiple concurrent workstreams.
Strong technical fluency across modern software delivery, including application development, APIs and integrations, cloud, data and analytics, automation, testing, CI/CD and production operations.
Experience delivering AI-enabled solutions and sufficient understanding of generative and agentic AI to manage dependencies, risks and delivery considerations related to data, models, evaluation, guardrails and non-deterministic behavior.
Demonstrated experience navigating enterprise technology governance and regulated environments, including architecture, security, privacy, risk, compliance and production-readiness processes.
A clear and influential communicator who can translate between business and technical stakeholders, create structure in ambiguous environments, surface issues early and drive accountability for delivery.

It would be great for you to have some of these additional qualities as well:

Experience managing portfolios spanning software applications, data and analytics, automation and AI solutions.
Experience establishing or scaling delivery governance, portfolio management or product-development operating models.
Familiarity with responsible AI, data governance, model risk and the controls required to move AI solutions into production.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP and delivery tooling such as Azure DevOps, Jira or similar.
Experience delivering technology solutions for Audit & Assurance, finance, accounting or other regulated business processes; project or program management credentials such as PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2 or equivalent are an asset.

The salary range for this position is $88,000 - $158,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and project management applications, processes, software, and equipment.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager I
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About The Role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What You’ll Do

Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What We Look For

8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.
Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000 - $188,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description:
About HUD

HUD's mission is to build reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI data. We want data to be valuable for the people who create it and trustworthy for the labs that train on it. Our team is a quickly growing group of researchers, engineers and operators building the economy that shapes what AI will become. Backed by $16M from top VCs and YC (W25), our marketplace and platform are used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. You’ll turn ambiguous technical asks into executable programs, coordinate the people and dependencies required to deliver them, and ensure the resulting data is genuinely useful for evaluating and improving LLMs and agents. You’ll also manage vendors and build the processes, tooling, and operating rhythms that allow HUD to deliver reliably at increasing scale.

Responsibilities

Own data and evaluation programs end-to-end, from initial scoping and requirements gathering through production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective
Translate ambiguous requests from AI labs and internal teams into clear specifications such as milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, etc.
Maintain and improve data quality procedures using both quantitative signals and qualitative inspection, including analyzing task coverage, difficulty, reward distributions, etc.
Maintain and improve delivery pipelines at scale, which includes managing external vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle
Streamline the logistics behind data production and evaluation programs by improving workflows, documentation, automation, and cross-functional handoffs
Partner with research, platform, marketplace teams to translate learnings and feedback into product improvements

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

Experience owning complex technical programs in AI/ML, data operations, support engineering, applied research, forward-deployed engineering, or a similarly cross-functional environment
Strong quantitative and qualitative judgment about data—you can move between aggregate metrics and individual examples to determine whether a dataset or evaluation is useful, reliable, and representative
Experience maintaining and improving complex processes, especially within project delivery or data contexts
Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, maintain momentum as requirements change, and make sound tradeoffs without waiting for a perfect specification
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn messy technical information into clear decisions, owners, and next steps

Experience with RLHF, reinforcement-learning environments, agent evaluations, human-in-the-loop data pipelines, annotation, or expert data collection

Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will serve as the strategic operational engine orchestrating complex software releases, hardware co-design, and AI-driven automation across Everpure’s enterprise storage portfolio. You will partner with global Engineering, Product Management, Security, and Supply Chain leaders to align cross-functional dependencies, oversee CapEx investments, and lead Product Lifecycle (PLC) gate reviews that deliver zero-downtime reliability. By integrating applied AI and advanced program analytics into development workflows, you will accelerate release velocity and ensure our platforms set the industry standard for performance and quality.

What You'll Do

End-to-End Program & AI-Enhanced Release Governance: Direct concurrent software release schedules, branch health metrics, leveraging AI tools to automate dependency tracking and risk forecasting.
Cross-Functional System & AI Integration: Drive alignment across global Engineering (Firmware, OS, Applied AI), Product Management, Security, and Field teams to resolve architectural blockers and achieve on-time program milestones with zero customer downtime.
Risk Mitigation & Architectural Triage: Lead bug scrubs, triage critical technical risks, manage Git-based merge payloads, and facilitate high-stakes trade-off decisions to balance release velocity with systemic platform stability.
Financial & Resource Stewardship: Manage program CapEx planning, execution tracking, and resource allocation to ensure engineering spend remains strictly within budget during monthly, quarterly, and annual review cycles.
Program Metrics and Health Indicators: Develop, track, and manage program indicators covering schedule, quality, risk, dependencies, readiness, cost, and overall execution health. Use program analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, forecast risks, and drive corrective action.

What You Bring

End-to-End Program & NPI Mastery: Deep expertise orchestrating complex software release cycles and New Product Introduction (NPI) and OS stacks.
Applied AI & Program Analytics Fluency: Proven capability leveraging AI workflows, predictive models, or automated program management tools to optimize release management, dependency tracking, and program risk assessments.
Strategic Problem Solving & Quality Ownership: Advanced analytical ability to establish release branch health metrics, navigate cross-functional dependencies, and apply data-backed insights to enforce rigorous architectural standards.
Cross-Functional Influence & Financial Governance: Demonstrated skill in driving accountability across global engineering teams without direct authority, alongside practical experience managing CapEx budgets and product cost controls.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

,

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

jobs.description:
About The Company

America is under sustained cyber attack. Our adversaries infiltrate our networks, steal our IP, and degrade the digital infrastructure that modern life runs on. They’ve learned—correctly—that those attacks rarely produce consequences.

Twenty was founded to change that, by making our adversaries think twice before they attack us. Our vision is American and allied primacy in cyberspace—a future where they cannot contest us, deterrence is assured, and the free world remains secure.

Founded in 2024, Twenty Technologies (www.twenty.io) industrializes offensive cyber operations for the U.S. and its allies. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Twenty has raised $168M from Khosla Ventures, Accel, Caffeinated Capital, Friends & Family Capital, Point72 Ventures, General Catalyst, and In-Q-Tel.

Role Summary

You will run how Twenty's product and engineering teams plan and commit. You'll own the planning cycle: the calendar, each stage from intake through close-out, the weekly status cadence, and the delivery forecast that leadership relies on. Product managers decide what gets built and when. Engineering managers decide how it gets built and who builds it. You make sure both follow the planning process, that requirements are ready for engineering to design against, that estimates hold up, and that every date comes with an honest confidence level.

Our software ships to government customers, and much of our roadmap is tied to deployment milestones that customers and missions depend on. Working with our deployment managers, you'll keep a register of those commitments, link each one to the roadmap work it needs, and make sure that when priorities change, the tradeoff against a commitment is made explicitly and on the record by the people who own it. Done well, this means customers and missions can count on what we've promised them, because any change to a commitment is a decision the right people made together.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering and work alongside your peers, Twenty's product managers, engineering managers, and deployment managers. The role is neutral: you hold everyone to the commitments they make, from individual teams to executive leadership. When plans and results start to diverge, you raise it early and work it through with them. When a problem needs a decision above the teams, you have the standing to take it directly to the VP of Engineering or the VP of Product. At Twenty, ideas are easy and execution is everything. This role keeps our pace aggressive and predictable at the same time.

Who You Are

You keep plans honest without turning planning into bureaucracy. Teams leave your sessions with a clearer plan and less overhead.
You have the engineering depth to question an estimate on its merits. You can tell when a size ignores a team's past velocity or leaves out integration and deployment work.
You say a date is at risk while there is still time to do something about it, and you say it in plain terms.
PMs and EMs trust you because you help fix the problems you find.
You hold product, engineering, and leadership to the same standard, and people on every side trust your read of the plan.
You use data on estimates and outcomes to make planning better each cycle, and you share it in a way that helps teams improve.
You write for two audiences: engineers who need the detail and executives who need the decision.
You're motivated by mission work, where a missed date affects a customer's operation.

What You'll Do

Run the planning cycle from intake through close-out. Lead planning sessions with PMs and EMs, and make sure requirements are clear enough to break down and design against before a team commits to the work.
Hold teams to the planning process. When a step gets skipped, work with the PM and EM to get it back on track, and bring it to the VPs only when the teams can't resolve it themselves.
Maintain the sizing standard, question estimates that don't hold up, and track estimates against actual effort so that they improve over time.
Own the rolling delivery forecast, with dates and confidence levels.
Run the status cadence across all active work, and produce the program-level rollup for executive leadership.
With the deployment managers, maintain the register of deployment milestones, link each one to the roadmap work it depends on, and review milestone health with them regularly.
When a roadmap change affects a milestone, make sure the PM, the deployment manager, and the right VP make the tradeoff explicitly.
Maintain the map of dependencies between teams and the program risk register.
Run end-of-cycle retros on how well plans matched results, and improve the planning process from what they show.

Must Have

You have 10+ years of experience in software organizations, including at least 7 years owning delivery planning across multiple teams as a technical program manager, engineering manager, or technical lead.
You have a software engineering background, or enough hands-on technical depth to read a design and judge whether its estimate is credible.
You can read a product requirements document and judge whether it's ready for engineering to break down and design against. When it isn't, you can say what's missing.
You learn a product and its customers' domain in enough depth to understand what each piece of work is for and whether or not its requirements, design, and estimate fit together.
You've run a recurring planning cycle for multiple teams, from intake through commitment and close-out, and you can describe what you changed when it wasn't working.
You've owned a delivery forecast or set of committed dates that leadership relied on, and you can show how you measured and improved its accuracy.
You've held people at every level, executives included, to the commitments they made, and kept their trust while doing it.
You've tracked engineering work against external commitments, such as customer deployments, contract milestones, or dates other organizations depended on.
You write clear, concise status reporting for engineering teams and for executives.
You must be eligible to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Nice to Have

You have experience in defense, intelligence, or national security technology programs.
You've coordinated software deployments to customer-controlled environments, such as private cloud, on-premises, or classified networks.
You've designed a planning process from scratch at a growing company.
You hold an active U.S. Government security clearance.
You've built program tracking and reporting in Linear, Notion, or equivalents such as Jira and Confluence, including automated status rollups.
You've used AI tools to cut the manual work of status reporting, tracking, and risk monitoring.

Tech Environment (You Might Work With)

Product and engineering teams building in Go, Python, React, and TypeScript
AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
Deployments to Twenty's cloud, customer private clouds, and on-site customer environments
Linear and Notion, or equivalents such as Jira and Confluence, for planning, tracking, and documentation

Benefits

What's on the table:

Health. Medical, dental, and vision plan options. Life / AD&D, disability coverage options.
Family. Paid parental leave for eligible full-time employees. 12 weeks for birthing parents, 4 for non-birthing parents, 6 weeks for adoptive, foster, or intended parents through surrogacy.
Vacation. Paid holidays and flexible PTO. Take what you need.
Retirement. 401(k) with pre-tax and Roth options. HSA/FSA options, dependent care FSA.

Benefits vary by location, role, and eligibility. Full plan details provided during the interview and offer process.

If this role sounds like you, apply and share with us your interest

Provide district-wide project controls leadership to construction management team. Conduct time and money analyses comparison of planned schedules and budgets versus field results. Policies and Procedures: Develop and implement procedures, processes and best practices. Recommend new initiatives to improve operations.

Develop best practices and ensure programs are operating consistently and effectively across the organization, and in alignment with performance targets. Ensure operations are conducted in compliance with state and federal policies, procedures and regulations.
Quality Assurance and Quality Control: Lead and perform quality assurance and quality control activities. District lead in project controls to include development of CEI budgets; monitoring expenditures; and developing and monitoring construction schedules. Conduct extensive constructability reviews. Attend concept meetings, field plan reviews and pre-construction meetings. Review plans and contract special provisions prior to construction work begin. Resolve issues by applying knowledge of policies, procedures, standards and principles. Respond to customer requests for service. In coordination with stakeholders facilitate creative solutions to complex issues.

Ability to analyze complex data and prepare reports.
Ability to apply design engineering principles to a variety of situations related to highway, structures, drainage and environmental areas.
Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with diverse audiences to include developing presentations and delivering training.
Ability to develop long and short range strategic plans and goals, set measures and evaluate results.

Ability to positively interact with employees, citizens and government officials.

Considerable knowledge of civil engineering and design engineering principles related to roadway, structures, drainage and environmental.
Considerable knowledge of engineering construction principles and practices and highway construction processes.
Considerable knowledge of quality assurance and quality control methods.
Demonstrated ability to promote continuous improvement of all aspects of contract construction and provide technical assistance to construction staff and design engineers.
Demonstrated ability to research and identify sound resolutions to construction problems.

jobs.title: Business Analyst | 12-month contract
jobs.description:
Description

About Leidos Australia

At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.

Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.

Benefits

Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes:

Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours.
Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.
Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities.
Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities.
Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way.
And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive.

About The Team

You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes.

Mission Software Systems (MSS) brings together expertise across intelligence, software, and cloud to deliver end-to-end capability supporting the full intelligence lifecycle, from planning through to dissemination and feedback. The team fosters a culture of innovation, leveraging modern engineering practices and shared infrastructure to rapidly build, test, and deploy software solutions across a range of environments, including cloud. MSS also plays a key role in advancing technology modernisation within Government, delivering scalable and adaptable solutions for complex enterprise challenges.

The Opportunity

Join the GEO SPACES Program, a nationally significant capability delivering geospatial and mission-critical systems that support Australia’s Defence and national security objectives.

This is an exciting 12-month contract opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst to join a collaborative team delivering business and technology initiatives that drive operational improvement and organisational outcomes. Working across a diverse range of stakeholders, you will play a key role in understanding business needs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and translating requirements into practical solutions that deliver measurable value.

You Will

Partner with business and technical stakeholders to elicit, analyse, and document business requirements, ensuring solutions align with strategic objectives and user needs.
Facilitate workshops, process mapping activities, and stakeholder engagement sessions to identify opportunities for improvement, manage requirements, and support informed decision-making.
Develop and maintain business process documentation, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria to support successful project delivery.
Work closely with project managers, technical teams, and business representatives throughout the project lifecycle, supporting solution design, testing, change activities, and implementation outcomes.

About You

You are an experienced Business Analyst who enjoys working with stakeholders to solve problems, improve business processes, and support the delivery of meaningful change. You bring a collaborative approach, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to translate complex business needs into clear and actionable requirements.

Essential

Experience in business analysis within project, transformation, technology, or operational environments.
Demonstrated ability to gather, analyse, and document business requirements, processes, user stories, and functional specifications.
Experience facilitating workshops and engaging with stakeholders across multiple business functions.
Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to solution design and business change initiatives.
Experience supporting testing activities, including requirements traceability, user acceptance testing, and defect management.
Well-developed communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Advantageous

Experience working in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.
Knowledge of business process modelling, continuous improvement methodologies, or change management practices.
Exposure to enterprise systems, digital transformation programs, data-driven initiatives, or technology implementation projects.
Relevant qualifications in Business Analysis, Information Technology, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Experience working within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations or large-scale project environments.

This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold an active NV2 Security Clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a DISA.

If this role interests you, we encourage you to apply. We value different experiences and are interested in the capability and potential you could bring.

What To Expect When You Apply

Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect:

An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team
An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel
Any role-specific assessment, technical discussion or customer step required for the position

We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know.

Ready to explore what’s possible?

If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact Praveena Sundarakumar, Talent Acquisition.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Operations Analyst & Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Aerospace Corporation seeks an experienced cybersecurity professional to serve as a Tier 2/3 Cyber Operations Analyst and Lead
our Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) program. You'll handle escalated security events, conduct advanced threat analysis, lead complex investigations, and own all aspects of threat intelligence collection, analysis, production, and dissemination. As a SOC subject matter expert, you'll leverage cutting-edge security tools and deep technical expertise to identify, analyze, and mitigate advanced cyber threats while mentoring junior analysts.

Work Model

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Colorado Springs, CO.

What You'll Be Doing

Cyber Threat Intelligence Program Leadership:

Lead Aerospace's CTI program, establishing strategy, processes, and capabilities
Develop CTI roadmap, define intelligence requirements (PIRs/IRs), and align with organizational risk priorities
Manage relationships with external threat intelligence partners, ISACs/ISAOs, and government agencies
Produce strategic, operational, and tactical intelligence products including threat assessments, adversary profiles, and campaign analysis
Conduct all-source intelligence analysis on threat actors and emerging threats targeting aerospace/defense
Manage threat intelligence platforms (TIP) and establish intelligence workflows
Track and profile APT groups and adversaries relevant to Aerospace's threat landscape
Brief leadership on threat trends, emerging risks, and intelligence-driven recommendations
Establish metrics demonstrating CTI program value and effectiveness

Security Operations & Incident Response

Serve as Tier 2/3 escalation point for complex security alerts and incidents
Conduct deep-dive investigations into sophisticated threats and APTs
Perform advanced threat hunting leveraging intelligence to guide hypotheses
Analyze security alerts from SIEM, IDS, EDR, and other security technologies
Correlate data from multiple sources to reconstruct attack timelines and identify compromise scope
Lead incident response for escalated events, coordinating containment and remediation
Integrate threat intelligence into detection workflows and develop advanced detection rules
Analyze malware, scripts, and attacker tools to understand adversary TTPs
Mentor Tier 1 analysts and develop their analytical skills
Create advanced playbooks, investigation workflows, and technical documentation
Generate detailed technical reports and executive summaries on complex threats
Provide after-hours escalation support for critical incidents as needed

Minimum Requirements For Information Security Staff III

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Intelligence Studies, or equivalent experience
3-5 years in security operations, threat analysis, incident response, or SOC environments
3+ years in cyber threat intelligence analysis, production, and program management
Proven experience building or managing a CTI program
Strong background in intelligence analysis methodologies, intelligence cycle (collection, processing, analysis, dissemination) & structured analytic techniques
Experience as Tier 2/3 SOC analyst handling complex security incidents
Experience producing intelligence products for various audiences (technical, operational, executive) and briefing stakeholders
Ability to analyze threat actors, track campaigns, and assess adversary capabilities
Advanced proficiency with SIEM platforms (Google SecOps, QRadar, LogRhythm, ArcSight, or similar) including custom query development
Hands-on experience with threat intelligence platforms (TIP) and OSINT tools
Deep understanding of network protocols, traffic analysis, and advanced attack techniques
Extensive log analysis and event correlation experience
Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux systems, forensic artifacts, and attacker techniques
Expertise with EDR platforms and advanced endpoint analysis
Expert-level understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework
Experience with threat intelligence frameworks (Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain)
Advanced network packet analysis skills (Wireshark, tcpdump)
Ability to analyze malicious scripts, PowerShell commands, and malware behavior
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple complex investigations
Ability to obtain and maintain US Secret clearance (US citizenship required)

Additional Requirements For Information Security Staff IV

5-7 years in security operations, threat analysis, incident response, or SOC environments
5+ years in cyber threat intelligence analysis, production, and program management

How You Can Stand Out

Certifications: GCTI, CTIA, GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GMON, CySA+, CISSP, etc.
Prior experience as CTI Lead, Manager, or Program Owner
Government, military, or defense intelligence background with formal training
Experience developing intelligence requirements and collection strategies
Advanced proficiency with ThreatConnect, Anomali, MISP, Recorded Future
OSINT research, dark web monitoring, and underground forum analysis experience
Malware analysis and reverse engineering skills
Published threat intelligence research or conference presentations
Scripting proficiency (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and analysis
Experience with SOAR platforms
Cloud security operations experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Experience in classified or high-security environments
Network security monitoring tools experience (Zeek, Suricata, Snort)
Red team/purple team exercise participation
Analyst mentoring and training experience
Knowledge of compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, 800-171, CMMC)
Familiarity with IC standards (ICD 203, ICD 206)

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager I
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About The Role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What You’ll Do

Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What We Look For

8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

A leader in cutting-edge research and technology in the cyber arena, CPMG focuses on using business drivers to guide cybersecurity activities and manage risk. CPMG offers flexible, integrative solutions for Department of Defense (DoD) contractors, among others, and specializes in cybersecurity, information and operational technology, electronic security surveillance, and support services.

Summary:

The Data Analyst - Journeyman (JNY) is responsible for analyzing structured and unstructured data to support decision-making across USSOCOM. This role involves working with data sets from various sources to develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that help leadership and operational teams gain actionable insights. The analyst will collaborate with database administrators, system engineers, and mission stakeholders to deliver high-quality, data-driven visualization solutions in support of SOCOM’s mission.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience working with data tools and visualization platforms. This position requires familiarity with databases, data modeling, business intelligence.
