jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Company

Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Supply Chain Program Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.

You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub-components
Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
Dual-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain

Supplier Relationship Management

Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts
Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics
Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules
Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

New Product Introduction: Partner with R&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability
Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime
Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end-to-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks

Requirements

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field
8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries
Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards)
Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations
Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena)
Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high-tech industries
Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long-term contracts in volatile markets.
Experience developing and executing successful, long-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components
Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning
Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

Other Requirements

This is a full-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office
Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%)

Benefits

Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
Free Food & Snacks
Stock Option Plan
Annual Bonus Plan eligible
Short Term & Long Term Disability
Base Salary: $140,000 - $160,000

Additional Information

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager I
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About The Role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What You’ll Do

Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What We Look For

8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.
Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000 - $188,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Project Manager
jobs.description:
Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.
Position Overview

The Internal Audit Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of internal audit projects across the organization. The Project Manager ensures audit engagements are performed according to the International Professional Practices Global Internal Audit Standards published by the Institute of Internal Auditors. The Project Manager plays a key role in identifying and assessing business risks, ensuring audit quality, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and integrity.
The Internal Audit Project Manager will report to the Deputy Head of Internal Audit
Key Responsibilities

Audit Planning & Leadership
Together with the Deputy Head of Internal Audit, lead the audit planning (including timeline and deadline definition), scope and resource allocation for audit engagements, ensuring alignment with objectives.
Supervise audit teams, providing direction, technical guidance, and coaching throughout the engagement.
Identify key business risks and ensure appropriate audit scoping for the audits under its direct management
Audit Execution & Quality Management
Oversee and ensure the execution of audits in accordance with IIA Global Internal Audit Standards and internal methodologies. It may do so under the leadership of the Deputy Head of Internal Audit or the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management.
Review workpapers, test results, and reports to guarantee consistency, accuracy, and professional standards.
Apply data analytics and digital audit tools to enhance audit efficiency and insight generation and risk detection whenever possible.
Monitor Internal Audit progress, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure deadlines are met.
For certain audits, may also lead the engagement from planning to execution and reporting under the leadership of the Deputy Head of Internal Audit
Stakeholder Engagement & Reporting
Prepare, review and present comprehensive audit reports that clearly communicate findings, risks, with appropriate management action plans.
Serve as a trusted business partner and advisor to management, fostering strong relationships across departments and geographies.
Communicate key audit findings, trends, and insights to senior management
Perform or oversee the Management Action Plan implementation follow-up, ensure timeline closure of internal audit actions
Continuous Improvement & Team Development
Contribute to the evolution of audit methodologies, templates, and digital tools.
Mentor, coach, and develop internal audit staff, promoting a culture of learning and excellence
Stay current with regulatory developments, risk trends, and the Global Internal Audit Standards

You will bring:

At least 8 years of proven experience in internal or external auditing, preferably within an industrial company
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, risk management, and governance principles.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and provide strategic recommendations.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Professional certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) are an asset.
Fluency in English

You will get:

The Portuguese annual base salary reasonably expected to be paid for this new hire is €48,400 to €60,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualification and internal equity and can ultimately be more or less than the posted salary range.
Benefits package
16, or more, weeks of maternity/paternity and co-parenting leave, according to local regulations
Training platform for all employees
Free well-being sessions (physical and psychological)

Additional information:

Location: Portugal, Lisbon
Hybrid working model
Travelling up to 20%

About Us

Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity.
At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. We encourage individuals who may require any assistance or accommodations to let us know to ensure a seamless application experience. We are here to support you throughout the application journey and want to ensure all candidates are treated equally. If you are unsure whether you meet all the criteria or qualifications listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Operations Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before?

How We Started

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where We Are Now

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where We’re Going

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

The Opportunity

The Ops Data Analyst role delivers accurate, timely and reliable insight across operational domains, including Clinical Operations, Medical, Customer Support and Physical Operations.

This role has a particular focus on physical and operational performance, including dispatch, SLA adherence, workflow volumes, supply chain management and fulfilment metrics, while also able to support the other areas of Ops analytics where required.

The Analyst works closely with physical operational stakeholders and is expected to independently manage medium-complexity analysis, escalating more ambiguous or high-risk investigations where appropriate.

What You’ll Do

Cross-Operational Reporting & Insight Delivery

Provide analytical support across core operational workflows, with a focus on physical operations:

Dispatch performance, SLA adherence, and fulfilment efficiency
Stock & work force management staff level reporting
Operational drivers impacting service levels
Consultation volumes and approval or rejection rates
Customer support performance metrics and workflow trends
Build and maintain dashboards that provide clear, structured visibility of operational performance.
Identify trends and drivers within operational datasets and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Support & Structured Analysis

Translate stakeholder questions into structured analytical approaches
Deliver medium-complexity analyses end-to-end
Support deeper or higher-risk investigations in collaboration with Senior Analysts
Analyse SLA adherence and operational performance metrics
Ensure outputs are commercially and operationally relevant

Data Quality & Governance

Own QA of analytical outputs
Contribute towards clear documentation and data governance topics
Understand data lineage across operational systems
Identify and flag upstream data or tracking issues
Follow established QA and governance standards

Experience

What you’ll bring to HeliosX

2–4 years’ experience in analytics or business intelligence
Experience analysing operational performance data
Understanding of metrics such as dispatch rate, SLAs, workflow volumes, and conversion funnels
Experience working with multiple data sources
Experience in fast paced network environments

Skills

Able to write basic SQL & understands SQL fundamentals to be able to validate independently
Cleans and transforms data from multiple sources
Builds complex reporting and dashboards
Experience with spreadsheeting tools
Experience of using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (Sage advantageous)
Use & experience of using WHS/WMS software e.g. blue yonder etc.
Experience with BI and visualisation tools
Ability to translate business questions into structured analytical approaches
Identifies trends and key drivers within datasets
Presents clear and concise insights
Project & stakeholder management handling and documenting multiple tasks (Jira & Sprint experience advantageous)

Life at HeliosX

At HeliosX, we’re building the future of healthcare. That means we need brilliant, mission-driven people who are excited to innovate, scale, and create change.

Here’s What You Can Expect

25 Days Holiday (+ public holidays)
Private healthcare, including dental and vision cover
Employee Pension with Smart Pension and enhanced parental leave
Cycle-to-work and Electric Car schemes
Free monthly products from Dermatica and MedExpress, plus family discounts
Home office allowance
Wellbeing perks: Headspace subscription, gym discounts, L&D budget, and free Audible subscription

jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 Organizations Worldwide Rely On SHI’s Concierge Approach To Help Them Solve What’s Next. But The Heartbeat Of SHI Is Our Employees – All 7,000 Of Them. If You Join Our Team, You’ll Enjoy

Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.
Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.
Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.
World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Operations Analyst will assist with vendor management and customer billing by working closely with the internal Project Management teams, Technical Account Management teams, Services Accounting, and SHI’s subcontractor network. They will work to improve processes, ensure process consistency, and ensure service projects are billed accurately and on time. The Analyst will also extract, analyze, and process billing data to generate customer invoices.

This position will report to a Manager within the PMO. This position is required to report to the Austin, TX office location as determined by SHI management. 

Role Description

Manage and process billing and invoicing, ensuring accuracy from subcontractor to customer.
Coordinate with internal and external teams to resolve billing issues and provide status updates.
Analyze and audit billing data to generate and process invoices accurately.
Act as a subject matter expert for billing and invoicing processes.
Develop and document process improvements to enhance efficiency.
Create reports and dashboards to monitor business health and future trends.
Communicate processes and act as a liaison between operations and other teams.
Define and manage business and technical requirements for projects.
Coordinate and manage projects from discovery to completion, providing updates to stakeholders.
Collaborate with stakeholders to implement system changes and improvements.

Behaviors and Competencies

Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.
Detail-Oriented: Can identify errors or inconsistencies in work and make necessary corrections.
Organization: Can prioritize daily tasks, manage personal workflow, and utilize basic tools to keep track of responsibilities.
Prioritization: Can identify critical tasks, arrange them based on importance, and execute without explicit instructions.
Multi-Tasking: Can identify opportunities for task optimization, propose solutions, and manage multiple tasks without explicit instructions.
Follow-Through: Can manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines without needing explicit reminders.
Continuous Improvement: Can identify moderate areas for improvement and implement moderate changes.
Data Analysis: Can identify patterns and trends in data, propose hypotheses, and use statistical techniques to test them.
Problem-Solving: Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action to resolve them without explicit instructions.
Collaboration: Can actively participate in team discussions, respect differing opinions, and collaborate with others to achieve common goals.

Skill Level Requirements

The ability to effectively utilize applications like Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook to enhance productivity and perform various tasks efficiently. - Basic
Proficient in utilizing Microsoft Excel for data analysis, including the use of formulas, functions, pivot tables, and data visualization tools. - Basic
Knowledge of various project management frameworks such as Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum, to effectively plan, execute, and close projects. - Basic

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
DATA ANALYST

About R/Ga And This Role

R/GA designs intelligent brand systems that help businesses get ahead.

The Data practice gives those systems their intelligence and proves we get brands ahead.

Reporting will always be part of the job. But our work is changing rapidly towards building the systems and solutions that help brands decide and act.

This role sits at the centre of that shift. A measurement framework can become a test-and-learn programme. A dashboard can become an always-on intelligence solution across multiple surfaces. Repeated manual analysis can become an automated pipeline. Your job is to deliver what is needed now and spot what it should become next.

On Any Given Day You Might

Develop measurement frameworks aligned to business goals & strategy.
Present performance results to a client and give them one clear recommendation, not five hedged options.
Implement, test and debug analytics tracking on a client's site or app.
Build and ship a working AI pipeline from a clear spec. Prompts, evaluation, data in and out, documented so a peer can run it.
Pull data from BigQuery, GA4, media platforms or a CRM and work out what it is actually saying.
Build a dashboard that a client opens every Monday and trusts. Then ask what it would take to make the dashboard unnecessary.
Take a reporting task you were handed and come back with the thing it should have been.
Write the spec for the next thing we build.

What We Expect From You On Day One

We are hiring for someone who already builds with AI because they cannot help themselves, who finds marketing data interesting, and who wants to learn from the team, the strategists, designers and technologists sitting next to them.

You have built something with AI. A side project, a university assignment, a work tool or a weekend experiment. You have written prompts that failed, fixed them and shipped something another person used. You can show us what you built, explain how you tested it and tell us what you would improve.
You care about AI beyond the hype. You read the model release notes. You experiment with new tools. You have opinions about where this is going and want to spend the next few years getting very good at applying it.
You find marketing fascinating. Media performance, website analytics, CRM, loyalty, brand health and search. You understand that these are connected systems that influence whether a brand grows, and you want to know how they work together.
You use numbers to change what happens next. A finding nobody acts on is a finding you have not finished. You care more about the decision the data drives than the chart it sits in, and you will push until someone does something differently because of what you found.

You Bring

Experience building with large language models. Prompt design, retrieval, evaluation, tool use or multi-step pipelines. Professional, academic or self-taught all count.
Experience taking data end-to-end from analysis and insight development through to clear, compelling presentations for senior and executive stakeholders. You can turn complex findings into a story that supports a decision.

for an existing vacancy in our Investment Data Architecture (IDArch)
team. Our team resides within the middle office and enables the organization to get more value from its investment data. We lead Modern Data Platform (MDP) enablement for the investment data domain, set the standards and governance that help business teams own and build trusted data products, and act as primary owners of the Investment Data Management platform, including security master, pricing master, and market reference data. We place high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and influence are growing enterprise-wide. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do

Partner with investment and operations stakeholders to understand their data needs, and translate them into clear business requirements, data definitions, business rules, and acceptance criteria for the technical team. 
Support business data owners in defining and preparing trusted, reusable investment datasets (data products) through intake, definition and readiness using agreed standards, and contribute to ongoing stewardship and lifecycle reviews.
Develop conceptual and logical investment data models with business owners and technical partners and explain them clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Collaborate with data engineers and business teams to define and validate business transformation rules and source-to-target mappings and confirm that delivered data meets business expectations. 
Work with data owners and stewards to define data quality rules and critical data elements and analyze data-quality exceptions and reconciliation breaks. 
Act as a subject-matter resource on security master, pricing, holdings and reference data across equity, fixed income, and derivatives, ensuring consistency across systems. 
Document data models, mappings, data flows and business processes, and contribute business glossary terms, data definitions and lineage information to support transparency and governance. 
Contribute to strategic data projects – including requirements, testing, and release validation – in collaboration with operations, engineering, and senior management. 
Identify opportunities to improve investment data usability, consistency and operational efficiency. 

What You Bring

A degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Analysis, or a related field. Progress toward a designation such as the CFA or FRM is an asset. 
3–5 years of experience in investment management or financial services, ideally in investment data management, investment operations, or business analysis. Hands-on knowledge of equity, fixed income, or derivative data is required; experience with security master, pricing, or an Enterprise Data Management (EDM) platform is a plus. 
Proven ability to elicit requirements, run working sessions, and turn ambiguous business needs into clear, documented requirements and acceptance criteria. 
SQL is an asset; familiarity with Python, PySpark, Lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric or similar data platforms is a plus. 
Exposure to conceptual or logical data modeling, or experience defining data entities, relationships and business rules, is an asset.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to business users and business needs to technical teams. 
A curious, detail-oriented self-starter who takes initiative and delivers outcomes with measurable results.

Responsabilidades

Desarrollo de Reportes con Enfoque Visual: Diseñar, construir y actualizar dashboards en Tableau, Power BI o Looker Studio, aplicando nociones básicas de Data Storytelling para estructurar la información de forma lógica, clara y limpia.

Seguimiento y Comunicación: Comunicar proactivamente al Manager cualquier inconsistencia en los datos, retrasos operativos o bloqueos técnicos en las conexiones de APIs o plataformas.

Requisitios

Experiencia y precisión en la transformación y validación de datos numéricos para evitar errores en reportes.
Capacidad para priorizar entregas diarias y cumplir con los tiempos de respuesta acordados.
Interés por entender los mecanismos del marketing digital y cómo los datos se convierten en insights.

Nociones básicas/intermedias de SQL para la extracción, filtrado y transformación de tablas de datos.

Entendimiento general de los canales de medios pagados (Search, Social, Display, Video, Programmatic) y las palancas que un digital marketer opera para influir en los resultados.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. You’ll turn ambiguous technical asks into executable programs, coordinate the people and dependencies required to deliver them, and ensure the resulting data is genuinely useful for evaluating and improving LLMs and agents. Translate ambiguous requests from AI labs and internal teams into clear specifications such as milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, etc.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Accounting Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic is seeking a Program Manager to join our Accounting organization and help it run as one global team. Accounting is scaling at an unprecedented pace across multiple hubs, and the goals, rhythms, programs, and people that make up the team need to stay connected as we grow. In this role, you will own that connective tissue: the annual goal-setting cycle, the leadership team’s operating cadence, org-wide events and internal communications, and the programs that make a distributed team feel like one.

You will partner with Accounting leadership, the People team, Finance Systems, and hub leads. This is a hands-on role with a lot of range: part chief of staff, part program manager, part culture builder.

Responsibilities

Goals and operating rhythm

Run the annual goal setting process and the reporting that tracks progress against those goals.
Look at how the org actually operates (meetings, handoffs, planning cycles, decision making) and fix what isn't working.
Maintain one org-wide planning calendar that shows close, audit, and team milestones alongside company-wide and team events, so leaders can see the pressure points and plan around them.
Build and maintain a simple set of org health metrics (attrition, engagement scores, hiring pipeline, training completion, survey trends) and report on them regularly.

Leadership and org-wide events

Run our extended leadership team (XLT) program, including agendas, meetings, follow-ups, and action items.
Own planning and agenda for the annual offsite and run the quarterly team all-hands.
Write the internal updates: a regular team newsletter, plus talking points when leadership needs to explain a change to the whole org.

People and culture

Coordinate projects across the org that support employee experience programs.
Partner with the People team to roll out training and development programs for Accounting.
Review team survey results, identify the themes, and build action plans to address the feedback. Follow through and report back to the team.
Run hub programs, including visit and rotation programs, local hub events, and meeting norms that work across time zones, so we feel like one global team.
Run recognition and team rituals: wins, milestones, anniversaries, and peer recognition, especially across hubs.

Team operations

Support contractor management, including onboarding, tracking, and coordination with the right partners.
Keep the team's knowledge base current: wiki, org charts, role descriptions, and key process docs.
Keep the team calendar accurate so everyone knows what's coming.

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years in program management, operations, chief of staff, or strategy roles. Experience inside a finance or accounting org is a plus, but not required.
A track record of running recurring programs end to end and getting people to follow through without formal authority.
Good judgment about what matters and what doesn't. You can handle a lot of moving pieces without dropping them.
Clear, direct writing. You can brief a senior leader in a few sentences.
Comfort with confidential information and sensitive people topics.
Experience supporting distributed or global teams.
You're organized, but you also know when a process is getting in the way and should be simplified.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Data Analyst II - Maternal Health Policy and Equity
jobs.description:
Description

Job Description

The Data Analyst II oversees activities related to data integrity, security and enhancement of the value of data. The Data Analyst II may direct the movement of data across multiple systems; oversee its validation and organization and make sure that data is available to appropriate people and systems within an organization. The Data Analyst II will also develop and execute reports that will be important assets of the practice as they continue to develop and evaluate a new model of care.

The Department of Population Health Science and Policy is seeking a Data Analyst II to work on projects related to maternal health policy and equity, pregnancy-related influences to lifecourse cardiometabolic disease, school-level influences on adolescent preconception health, economic evaluation, and health services research. The Data Analyst II will be an integral member of our research teams, and will collaborate with study investigators (including epidemiologists, health economists, OBGYNs, etc), and other research team members on projects related to maternal health disparities and inequities. This is a one-year position with an opportunity for longer-term renewal.

The ideal candidate would be: 1) highly motivated and responsible; 2) an effective communicator; 3) extremely organized and detail-oriented; 4) someone who combines initiative with responsiveness to supervision; 5) someone comfortable asking questions and eager to learn; and, 6) flexible and able to shift gears as new tasks present themselves. Opportunities exist for mentorship and professional development for Data Analysts.

Responsibilities

Plan, organize, conduct, and communicate data-intensive analysis and research within the overall scope of cardiovascular disease prevention, economic evaluation, maternal health disparities, and health equity.
Develop required research skills in health services research and quantitative analysis
Engage in data management, regression-based data analysis, and manuscript writing
Guide and mentor research interns
Communicate and work with internal and external collaborators.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in computer science, statistics and/or related field required, or combination of equivalent work experience and education. Masters degree in relevant field of study preferred (e.g., statistics, epidemiology, computer science, etc.).
3+ years of analytics experience including report development and database application/management experience, preferably in a large medical center or healthcare environment

Preferred

Strong quantitative skills and proficiency working with data analysis tools such as STATA, SAS, and R.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Highly motivated and interested in developing a research career.
Able to work independently in a multidisciplinary setting.
Experience working with systems science modelling methodologies such as system dynamics and agent-based modelling is not required but a plus.

The Project Manager's (PM) role is to plan and manage construction activities from conception to completion of the project in a timely and cost-effective manner. The PM responsibilities include, but are not limited to; project planning, budget management, schedule implementation, compliance with quality standards, contract administration and safety program management. 

GENERAL INFORMATION:
- Project Manager
- Exempt position
- Worksite location at construction jobsite trailer, or main offices, depending on company needs
- Reports to executive team members (VP of Construction, VP of Operations, CEO, etc.)

new_jobs.description:
Job title
: Security Project Manager (SPM)
Reports to
: Regional Security Manager (RSM) – ANZ
Location
: Melbourne, Australia (Remote)

Mandatory Requirement:
NV1 clearance required for the role (Must Have)

About our team

We are a dynamic, dedicated team that provides management and support for a global guarding services account that spans across 30+ countries. Our client is an industry-leading datacenter organization, and we pride ourselves on delivering best-in-class solutions through our teams made up of Security Operations, Shared Services, Threat and Incident Management, Environmental Health and Safety, and Human Resources. As part of this team, you'll work alongside a group of professionals committed to excellence and innovation.

About the role

The Security Project Manager is responsible for leading the implementation, testing, commissioning, and delivery of physical security systems supporting our large, complex, global client that involves critical infrastructure portfolio across the APAC region. This role manages high-profile and business-critical projects involving access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarm systems, radio communications, and other physical security technologies across datacenters, leased colocation facilities, and other critical infrastructure environments.

Working across multiple concurrent projects, the Security Project Manager partners with architects, engineers, construction managers, security vendors, and client stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered in accordance with established standards, timelines, budgets, and operational requirements. The role requires strong project management skills, a solid technical understanding of physical security systems, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams while delivering consistent project outcomes.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will lead the implementation, testing, commissioning, and deployment of physical security systems, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with established security standards. You will review security designs and project documentation, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure consistency, compliance, cost efficiency, and quality throughout the project lifecycle.

You will oversee multiple security projects across the APAC region, supporting project planning, scheduling, budgeting, reporting, and performance tracking while collaborating closely with architects, engineers, construction teams, vendors, and client representatives. You will drive continuous improvement initiatives through process optimisation, automation, reporting, and data-driven decision-making to enhance the efficiency, scalability, and maturity of the physical security program.

You will act as a trusted advisor to internal and external stakeholders, support incident response activities, represent the client's physical security program, and contribute to strategic initiatives that improve operational performance. You will also maintain strict confidentiality, ensure stakeholder requirements are effectively managed, and support additional projects, reporting requirements, and leadership priorities as required.

What you need to apply

To be successful in this role, you should possess a bachelor's degree in business, security, engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of project or construction management experience, including at least three years managing the deployment of physical security systems or security engineering solutions. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will also be considered.

You should have strong knowledge of physical security technologies, including access control, intrusion detection, alarm monitoring, and video surveillance systems, along with experience implementing and supporting physical security systems throughout construction project lifecycles. new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Silicon Quantum Computing (SQC) is at the forefront of global efforts to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer, while delivering quantum-enhanced AI and simulation products to customers today.

Backed by over 25 years of technological excellence, SQC is a full-stack quantum computing company that leverages its proprietary manufacturing process to engineer atomic qubits in silicon with 0.13 nanometer precision. It is the most precise semiconductor manufacturing in the world, enabling systems with world-leading algorithmic fidelity, and a decisive advantage in the global quantum computing race.

Our products are commercially deployed and generating revenue. Watermelon, our quantum-enhanced AI system, is delivering superior results on real-world problems across energy, telecom and finance. Quantum Twins, our simulation platform, provides unparalleled ability to model quantum systems, accelerating molecule and materials discovery.

This is SQC: building the future of computing while delivering quantum impact today.

About The Role

SQC builds gate-based quantum computers in silicon. Our largest programmes are multi-year commitments to US government sponsors, delivered against fixed benchmarks, milestones and independent evaluation. We are hiring a Technical Project Manager into Projects, the team that plans and delivers those programmes.

You will own the detailed schedule end to end, across hardware tasks, software workstreams and partner deliverables, not just the high-level roadmap. That means holding a critical path that runs through fabrication, measurement, engineering and external subcontractors, and running structured risk assessment as a standing discipline rather than an occasional exercise. Predictability is the core of the job. You will flag early that a milestone is at risk of slipping rather than surfacing it after the fact, and when new information or a blocker lands, you will adjust the plan quickly and make the consequences clear to the people who need to act on them.

You will own the commercial side of the programme too: the budget, tracked against the annual projections we hold with our investors, with variances flagged early and visible to management, alongside funding proposals and the subcontractors delivering into the programme. You will own the government interface, including the independent verification and validation relationship, keeping internal schedules aligned to sponsor milestones and holding the programme accountable to the exit criteria it will be judged against. You will also support our quantum machine learning customer interface, keeping programme schedules and customer commitments aligned, keeping QML customers informed of deliverable timelines and test results as they feed into the programme, and escalating commercial priorities or scope changes rather than absorbing them into the plan.

Based at our Sydney facility, you will work across nearly every team in the business, moving between technical detail with engineers, clear synthesis for management, and concise updates for the executive and the CEO. This is a role for someone with a genuine project management mindset: structured, disciplined about following defined processes rather than improvising case by case, personally committed to milestones, and comfortable challenging engineering estimates, holding teams to their commitments and pushing back when delivery slips.

Role Responsibilities

Own the detailed delivery schedule across multiple workstreams, covering hardware tasks alongside software and partner deliverables
Build and maintain a credible critical path, and keep multi-team work moving transparently and to a high technical bar
Run structured risk assessment as a recurring responsibility, identifying dependencies early and maintaining mitigation plans against them
Flag milestone risk before it materialises, then replan and communicate the consequences as soon as a blocker or new information emerges
Hold teams accountable to their commitments, challenge engineering estimates and priorities, and escalate where delivery is slipping
Own the government interface, including the independent verification and validation (IV&V) relationship, planning test and evaluation against exit criteria and packaging results into the reporting and reviews sponsors expect
Own and track the programme budget, maintaining alignment between actual spend and the annual projections agreed with our investors, and flagging variances early
Develop funding proposals and manage subcontractors, including statements of work, deliverables, commercial terms and spend against plan
Prioritise across competing demands so effort lands on the highest-impact work
Communicate across levels, from technical detail with the teams through to concise high-level updates for management and the CEO
Work to defined programme and quality processes, applying them consistently across the programme
Build the processes, systems and tooling that help our researchers and engineers move faster

Your Experience

A track record of delivering complex technical programmes against fixed external milestones, where the deadline does not move and the reporting bar is high
Experience owning detailed delivery schedules across hardware and software workstreams, including external partners and subcontractors
A background in hardware electronics, semiconductor, test engineering or manufacturing programme management, or another environment where hardware dependencies carry real schedule risk
A structured approach to risk, identifying dependencies early and maintaining credible mitigation plans rather than reporting problems after they land
Experience owning a programme budget, tracking spend against plan and reporting variance
Experience managing subcontractors, statements of work, deliverables and commercial terms
Comfortable operating to defined processes and formal quality requirements rather than improvising case by case
Willing to hold the line, challenging estimates and priorities and pushing back when delivery slips
Strong communication and stakeholder management in a matrix environment, adjusting register between engineers, management and executives
A fast learner, comfortable ramping up on unfamiliar technical domains and picking up the quantum and cryogenic vocabulary on the job
Experience delivering to government-funded research programmes or under independent evaluation is desirable but not essential

Equal opportunity

SQC is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and encourage applications from candidates who may not meet every listed requirement. If you’re excited about the role and believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply.

Export controls

This position may require access to export-controlled information or technology. Employment may be subject to applicable export control laws and may require eligibility assessment based on factors such as nationality, citizenship, or residency, and, where necessary, obtaining relevant export licenses or approvals.

About SQC

SQC was founded by renowned physicist and materials scientist Michelle Simmons, who pioneered the field of atomic electronics, including the development of the world’s first single-atom transistor and the first integrated circuit built with atomic precision. Our Chair, Simon Segars, former CEO of Arm, is a leader in the semiconductor industry and was instrumental in developing the processors that powered the mobile computing revolution.

As a full-stack company with in-house QPU manufacturing, SQC can design, produce and test new quantum chips in under a week, enabling rapid iteration and a decisive advantage in the race to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer.

SQC is a high-accountability environment built on a simple principle: Every Atom Counts. If you’re looking to play a meaningful role in building the next frontier of computing, we’d love to hear from you.

HUD's mission is to build reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI data. We want data to be valuable for the people who create it and trustworthy for the labs that train on it. Our team is a quickly growing group of researchers, engineers and operators building the economy that shapes what AI will become. Backed by $16M from top VCs and YC (W25), our marketplace and platform are used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. You’ll turn ambiguous technical asks into executable programs, coordinate the people and dependencies required to deliver them, and ensure the resulting data is genuinely useful for evaluating and improving LLMs and agents. You’ll also manage vendors and build the processes, tooling, and operating rhythms that allow HUD to deliver reliably at increasing scale.

Responsibilities

Own data and evaluation programs end-to-end, from initial scoping and requirements gathering through production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective
Translate ambiguous requests from AI labs and internal teams into clear specifications such as milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, etc.
Maintain and improve data quality procedures using both quantitative signals and qualitative inspection, including analyzing task coverage, difficulty, reward distributions, etc.
Maintain and improve delivery pipelines at scale, which includes managing external vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle
Streamline the logistics behind data production and evaluation programs by improving workflows, documentation, automation, and cross-functional handoffs
Partner with research, platform, marketplace teams to translate learnings and feedback into product improvements

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

Experience owning complex technical programs in AI/ML, data operations, support engineering, applied research, forward-deployed engineering, or a similarly cross-functional environment
Strong quantitative and qualitative judgment about data—you can move between aggregate metrics and individual examples to determine whether a dataset or evaluation is useful, reliable, and representative
Experience maintaining and improving complex processes, especially within project delivery or data contexts
Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, maintain momentum as requirements change, and make sound tradeoffs without waiting for a perfect specification
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn messy technical information into clear decisions, owners, and next steps

Strong Candidates May Also

Experience with RLHF, reinforcement-learning environments, agent evaluations, human-in-the-loop data pipelines, annotation, or expert data collection
Experience supporting frontier AI labs, technical enterprise customers, or research teams with urgent and evolving requirements
Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.

Team & Company Details

Team Size : ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.
Our team: Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.
Company stage: We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

Logistics

Employment : Full-time.
Location : We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who can work hours that 70-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.
Visa Sponsorship : We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full-time candidates to the US or Singapore.
Timeline : Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2-3 day work trial.

What we offer

Competitive compensation
100% covered top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision (US and Singapore employees)
Lunch and dinner for in-office employees
Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays
Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees) and a health/wellness stipend (Singapore employees)
Unlimited* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. *By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.
Two top-floor offices in San Francisco’s Union Square and Singapore’s Raffles Place
Annual travel budget to visit either office

Compensation

Actual offers are adjusted for experience and location, but our base salary bands are

San Francisco (and other major US cities): $130,000 - $225,000
Singapore: $100,000 - $170,000
Rest of world: $100,000 - $170,000

new_jobs.description:
Introduction

The Maryland State Department of Education is dedicated to supporting a world-class educational system that prepares all students for college and career success in the 21st century. With excellent stewardship from our divisions, we oversee State and federal programs that support the needs of a diverse population – students, teachers, principals, and other educators throughout Maryland.

GRADE

22

Salary based on experience and Agency budget allowance; State Salary Guidelines may apply

LOCATION OF POSITION

Nancy S. Grasmick Education Building

200 W. Baltimore Street

Baltimore, MD 21201

Hybrid schedule available (up to 3 telework days permitted each week)

POSITION DUTIES

This position provides leadership and technical expertise to support the development and implementation of statewide assessments for grades prekindergarten through high school. The position provides facilitation and coordination of Maryland State Department of Education (MSDE) staff, the staff of contractors, and the staff of local education agencies (LEAs) responsible for implementation of online testing in schools throughout the state. This position also assists with the training and monitoring of the LEA 24-Special Placement Schools.

Responsibilities Include

Communicate with LEA24 executive and education directors regarding MSDE updates, revisions, and requirements related to the administration of statewide assessments.
Provide direction and support to MSDE Assessment Program Managers, Local Accountability Coordinators, LEA Chief Information Officers, and LEA- and school-based staff regarding statewide assessment implementation and related operational issues.
Develop and disseminate protocols and best practices for the effective implementation of statewide assessments.
Provide guidance to LEA24 schools in developing plans to support the successful implementation of statewide assessments.
Monitor operational issues identified through vendor help desks and other sources, analyze trends, and formulate recommendations for resolution or process improvement.
Coordinate assessment administration readiness activities across LEA.
Coordinate user acceptance testing and operational reviews of vendor-provided assessment systems and related functionality prior to statewide implementation.
Conduct site visits to LEA offices and LEA24 schools to support online testing implementation and assess operational readiness.
Identify recurring issues and recommend changes to assessment systems, processes, training, and documentation to improve the statewide testing experience.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
A Master’s degree or the equivalent of 36 credit hours of post-baccalaureate coursework from an accredited college or university.

Experience:
Five years of professional experience in the coordination, planning, implementation, or administration of large-scale assessments at the school, district, or state level, including responsibility for assessment operations, testing logistics, implementation readiness, or the resolution of assessment administration issues.

Notes

Candidates may substitute a Bachelor’s degree and two additional years of experience directly related to the position option for the required education.
Candidates may substitute the possession of a Doctorate degree at an accredited college or university in a field related to the position for one year of the required experience.
The required field of education and experience are unique for each option and are established by MSDE in accordance with Education Article, Section 2-104 of the Annotated Code of Maryland. The specific education and experience qualifications for each position are on record in the Human Resources Branch.
Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience as a commissioned officer in Education Program classifications or Education Program specialty codes in the Education field of work on a year-for-year basis for the required experience and education.

Desired Or Preferred Qualifications

Preference will be given to applicants who possess the following preferred qualification(s). Include clear and specific information on your application regarding your qualifications.

Experience coordinating, managing, or overseeing assessment administration at the school, local education agency (LEA), or state level.
Experience designing, developing, and delivering professional learning for diverse audiences.
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders, including executive-level leadership.
In-depth knowledge of database management, including data organization, maintenance, analysis, and reporting.

Special Requirements

Applicants must consent to a State Police Investigation (fingerprinting) as a routine procedure for all employees with this Agency.

SELECTION PROCESS

Please make sure that you provide sufficient information on your application to show that you meet the qualifications for this recruitment. All information concerning your qualifications must be submitted by the closing date. The resulting list of eligible candidates will be in effect for at least one year.

Benefits

STATE OF MARYLAND BENEFITS

FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS

It is preferred that applicants complete the MD State Government online application for employment. The application must clearly demonstrate that you meet the qualifications for the position. If you are unable to apply online, paper applications can be obtained from the link below and mailed to MSDE Human Resources Branch, 200 W. Baltimore Street, Baltimore, MD 21201. If there is a supplemental questionnaire, this must be completed and sent in with your paper application, if you are unable to apply online.

All application materials must be received in our office by the closing date. Postmarks will not be accepted. Applications must be complete to be considered including all related job duties, even if those are also listed on an attached resume. Additional required materials may be uploaded with the online application or mailed to the Human Resources Branch address listed above.

Inquiries can be made to 410-767-0012, TTY Users: Call via Maryland Relay. Appropriate accommodations can be made for individuals with disabilities.

If you have difficulty with your user account or have general questions about this online application system, please contact the MD Department of Budget and Management, Recruitment and Examination Division at 410-767-4850. TTY Users: Call via Maryland Relay.

Proof of eligibility to work is required in compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act. Any misrepresentation of academic or experience requirements for this position may result in non-selection or termination of employment.

As an equal opportunity employer, Maryland is committed to recruiting, retaining and promoting employees who are reflective of the State’s diversity. People with disabilities and bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

We thank our Veterans for their service to our country.

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

What will your typical day look like?

Manage delivery across a portfolio of concurrent software, automation, data and AI initiatives, coordinating plans, priorities, dependencies, resources and milestones across the team.
Establish and run a consistent delivery cadence from intake and design through build, quality review, deployment, adoption and ongoing measurement.
Partner with Product Owners and Technical Leads to translate priorities into executable plans, resolve cross-team dependencies and proactively manage delivery risks, issues and decisions.
Guide solutions through required technology governance, architecture, security, privacy, risk and compliance processes, ensuring required reviews and artifacts are incorporated into delivery.
Maintain clear visibility into portfolio status, capacity, commitments and delivered value; provide concise reporting to leadership and continuously improve the team's delivery practices and ways of working

About The Team

AIDA (AI, Data & Analytics) builds technology solutions that transform how Audit & Assurance work gets done. We combine modern software engineering, AI and automation to create tools that simplify complex processes, reduce manual effort and enable teams to work more efficiently and effectively. Our solutions range from purpose-built applications and workflow automation to generative and agentic AI experiences that integrate with enterprise data and systems. We are looking for a senior project management leader who can bring structure, discipline and transparency to how these solutions move from idea to production — coordinating across business and technical teams and helping establish a scalable delivery model for the AIDA portfolio

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

You are someone with these required skills, experience & qualifications:

10+ years of project, program or technology delivery experience, with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional technology initiatives and multiple concurrent workstreams.
Strong technical fluency across modern software delivery, including application development, APIs and integrations, cloud, data and analytics, automation, testing, CI/CD and production operations.
Experience delivering AI-enabled solutions and sufficient understanding of generative and agentic AI to manage dependencies, risks and delivery considerations related to data, models, evaluation, guardrails and non-deterministic behavior.
Demonstrated experience navigating enterprise technology governance and regulated environments, including architecture, security, privacy, risk, compliance and production-readiness processes.
A clear and influential communicator who can translate between business and technical stakeholders, create structure in ambiguous environments, surface issues early and drive accountability for delivery.

It would be great for you to have some of these additional qualities as well:

Experience managing portfolios spanning software applications, data and analytics, automation and AI solutions.
Experience establishing or scaling delivery governance, portfolio management or product-development operating models.
Familiarity with responsible AI, data governance, model risk and the controls required to move AI solutions into production.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP and delivery tooling such as Azure DevOps, Jira or similar.
Experience delivering technology solutions for Audit & Assurance, finance, accounting or other regulated business processes; project or program management credentials such as PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2 or equivalent are an asset.

The salary range for this position is $88,000 - $158,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

Turns over completed project equipment/systems to the owner with all necessary documentation, training, and instructions.

History of safe performance, active safety involvement and participation and strong desire for a safer workplace.

Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and project management applications, processes, software, and equipment.

Demonstrated cross-functional project leadership experience, team performance skills, service mindset approach, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor.
