new_jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About The Role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What You’ll Do

Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What We Look For

8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.
Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000 - $188,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Product managers decide what gets built and when. Engineering managers decide how it gets built and who builds it. You make sure both follow the planning process, that requirements are ready for engineering to design against, that estimates hold up, and that every date comes with an honest confidence level.

Our software ships to government customers, and much of our roadmap is tied to deployment milestones that customers and missions depend on. Working with our deployment managers, you'll keep a register of those commitments, link each one to the roadmap work it needs, and make sure that when priorities change, the tradeoff against a commitment is made explicitly and on the record by the people who own it. Done well, this means customers and missions can count on what we've promised them, because any change to a commitment is a decision the right people made together.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering and work alongside your peers, Twenty's product managers, engineering managers, and deployment managers. The role is neutral: you hold everyone to the commitments they make, from individual teams to executive leadership. When plans and results start to diverge, you raise it early and work it through with them. When a problem needs a decision above the teams, you have the standing to take it directly to the VP of Engineering or the VP of Product. At Twenty, ideas are easy and execution is everything. This role keeps our pace aggressive and predictable at the same time.

Who You Are

You keep plans honest without turning planning into bureaucracy. Teams leave your sessions with a clearer plan and less overhead.
You have the engineering depth to question an estimate on its merits. You can tell when a size ignores a team's past velocity or leaves out integration and deployment work.
You say a date is at risk while there is still time to do something about it, and you say it in plain terms.
PMs and EMs trust you because you help fix the problems you find.
You hold product, engineering, and leadership to the same standard, and people on every side trust your read of the plan.
You use data on estimates and outcomes to make planning better each cycle, and you share it in a way that helps teams improve.
You write for two audiences: engineers who need the detail and executives who need the decision.
You're motivated by mission work, where a missed date affects a customer's operation.

What You'll Do

Run the planning cycle from intake through close-out. Lead planning sessions with PMs and EMs, and make sure requirements are clear enough to break down and design against before a team commits to the work.
Hold teams to the planning process. When a step gets skipped, work with the PM and EM to get it back on track, and bring it to the VPs only when the teams can't resolve it themselves.
Maintain the sizing standard, question estimates that don't hold up, and track estimates against actual effort so that they improve over time.
Own the rolling delivery forecast, with dates and confidence levels.
Run the status cadence across all active work, and produce the program-level rollup for executive leadership.
With the deployment managers, maintain the register of deployment milestones, link each one to the roadmap work it depends on, and review milestone health with them regularly.
When a roadmap change affects a milestone, make sure the PM, the deployment manager, and the right VP make the tradeoff explicitly.
Maintain the map of dependencies between teams and the program risk register.
Run end-of-cycle retros on how well plans matched results, and improve the planning process from what they show.

Must Have

You have 10+ years of experience in software organizations, including at least 7 years owning delivery planning across multiple teams as a technical program manager, engineering manager, or technical lead.
You have a software engineering background, or enough hands-on technical depth to read a design and judge whether its estimate is credible.
You can read a product requirements document and judge whether it's ready for engineering to break down and design against. When it isn't, you can say what's missing.
You learn a product and its customers' domain in enough depth to understand what each piece of work is for and whether or not its requirements, design, and estimate fit together.
You've run a recurring planning cycle for multiple teams, from intake through commitment and close-out, and you can describe what you changed when it wasn't working.
You've owned a delivery forecast or set of committed dates that leadership relied on, and you can show how you measured and improved its accuracy.
You've held people at every level, executives included, to the commitments they made, and kept their trust while doing it.
You've tracked engineering work against external commitments, such as customer deployments, contract milestones, or dates other organizations depended on.
You write clear, concise status reporting for engineering teams and for executives.
You must be eligible to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Nice to Have

You have experience in defense, intelligence, or national security technology programs.
You've coordinated software deployments to customer-controlled environments, such as private cloud, on-premises, or classified networks.
You've designed a planning process from scratch at a growing company.
You hold an active U.S. Government security clearance.
You've built program tracking and reporting in Linear, Notion, or equivalents such as Jira and Confluence, including automated status rollups.
You've used AI tools to cut the manual work of status reporting, tracking, and risk monitoring.

Tech Environment (You Might Work With)

Product and engineering teams building in Go, Python, React, and TypeScript
AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
Deployments to Twenty's cloud, customer private clouds, and on-site customer environments
Linear and Notion, or equivalents such as Jira and Confluence, for planning, tracking, and documentation

Benefits vary by location, role, and eligibility. Full plan details provided during the interview and offer process.

This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp.

new_jobs.description:
Description

About Leidos Australia

At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.

Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.

Benefits

Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes:

Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours.
Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.
Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities.
Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities.
Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way.
And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive.

About The Team

You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes.

Mission Software Systems (MSS) brings together expertise across intelligence, software, and cloud to deliver end-to-end capability supporting the full intelligence lifecycle, from planning through to dissemination and feedback. The team fosters a culture of innovation, leveraging modern engineering practices and shared infrastructure to rapidly build, test, and deploy software solutions across a range of environments, including cloud. MSS also plays a key role in advancing technology modernisation within Government, delivering scalable and adaptable solutions for complex enterprise challenges.

The Opportunity

Join the GEO SPACES Program, a nationally significant capability delivering geospatial and mission-critical systems that support Australia’s Defence and national security objectives.

This is an exciting 12-month contract opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst to join a collaborative team delivering business and technology initiatives that drive operational improvement and organisational outcomes. Working across a diverse range of stakeholders, you will play a key role in understanding business needs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and translating requirements into practical solutions that deliver measurable value.

You Will

Partner with business and technical stakeholders to elicit, analyse, and document business requirements, ensuring solutions align with strategic objectives and user needs.
Facilitate workshops, process mapping activities, and stakeholder engagement sessions to identify opportunities for improvement, manage requirements, and support informed decision-making.
Develop and maintain business process documentation, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria to support successful project delivery.
Work closely with project managers, technical teams, and business representatives throughout the project lifecycle, supporting solution design, testing, change activities, and implementation outcomes.

About You

You are an experienced Business Analyst who enjoys working with stakeholders to solve problems, improve business processes, and support the delivery of meaningful change. You bring a collaborative approach, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to translate complex business needs into clear and actionable requirements.

Essential

Experience in business analysis within project, transformation, technology, or operational environments.
Demonstrated ability to gather, analyse, and document business requirements, processes, user stories, and functional specifications.
Experience facilitating workshops and engaging with stakeholders across multiple business functions.
Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to solution design and business change initiatives.
Experience supporting testing activities, including requirements traceability, user acceptance testing, and defect management.
Well-developed communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Advantageous

Experience working in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.
Knowledge of business process modelling, continuous improvement methodologies, or change management practices.
Exposure to enterprise systems, digital transformation programs, data-driven initiatives, or technology implementation projects.
Relevant qualifications in Business Analysis, Information Technology, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Experience working within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations or large-scale project environments.

This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold an active NV2 Security Clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a DISA.

If this role interests you, we encourage you to apply. We value different experiences and are interested in the capability and potential you could bring.

What To Expect When You Apply

Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect:

An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team
An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel
Any role-specific assessment, technical discussion or customer step required for the position

We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know.

Ready to explore what’s possible?

If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact Praveena Sundarakumar, Talent Acquisition.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

new_jobs.title: Cybersecurity Operations Analyst & Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead
new_jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Aerospace Corporation seeks an experienced cybersecurity professional to serve as a Tier 2/3 Cyber Operations Analyst and Lead
our Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) program. You'll handle escalated security events, conduct advanced threat analysis, lead complex investigations, and own all aspects of threat intelligence collection, analysis, production, and dissemination. As a SOC subject matter expert, you'll leverage cutting-edge security tools and deep technical expertise to identify, analyze, and mitigate advanced cyber threats while mentoring junior analysts.

Work Model

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Colorado Springs, CO.

What You'll Be Doing

Cyber Threat Intelligence Program Leadership:

Lead Aerospace's CTI program, establishing strategy, processes, and capabilities
Develop CTI roadmap, define intelligence requirements (PIRs/IRs), and align with organizational risk priorities
Manage relationships with external threat intelligence partners, ISACs/ISAOs, and government agencies
Produce strategic, operational, and tactical intelligence products including threat assessments, adversary profiles, and campaign analysis
Conduct all-source intelligence analysis on threat actors and emerging threats targeting aerospace/defense
Manage threat intelligence platforms (TIP) and establish intelligence workflows
Track and profile APT groups and adversaries relevant to Aerospace's threat landscape
Brief leadership on threat trends, emerging risks, and intelligence-driven recommendations
Establish metrics demonstrating CTI program value and effectiveness

Security Operations & Incident Response

Serve as Tier 2/3 escalation point for complex security alerts and incidents
Conduct deep-dive investigations into sophisticated threats and APTs
Perform advanced threat hunting leveraging intelligence to guide hypotheses
Analyze security alerts from SIEM, IDS, EDR, and other security technologies
Correlate data from multiple sources to reconstruct attack timelines and identify compromise scope
Lead incident response for escalated events, coordinating containment and remediation
Integrate threat intelligence into detection workflows and develop advanced detection rules
Analyze malware, scripts, and attacker tools to understand adversary TTPs
Mentor Tier 1 analysts and develop their analytical skills
Create advanced playbooks, investigation workflows, and technical documentation
Generate detailed technical reports and executive summaries on complex threats
Provide after-hours escalation support for critical incidents as needed

Minimum Requirements For Information Security Staff III

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Intelligence Studies, or equivalent experience
3-5 years in security operations, threat analysis, incident response, or SOC environments
3+ years in cyber threat intelligence analysis, production, and program management
Proven experience building or managing a CTI program
Strong background in intelligence analysis methodologies, intelligence cycle (collection, processing, analysis, dissemination) & structured analytic techniques
Experience as Tier 2/3 SOC analyst handling complex security incidents
Experience producing intelligence products for various audiences (technical, operational, executive) and briefing stakeholders
Ability to analyze threat actors, track campaigns, and assess adversary capabilities
Advanced proficiency with SIEM platforms (Google SecOps, QRadar, LogRhythm, ArcSight, or similar) including custom query development
Hands-on experience with threat intelligence platforms (TIP) and OSINT tools
Deep understanding of network protocols, traffic analysis, and advanced attack techniques
Extensive log analysis and event correlation experience
Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux systems, forensic artifacts, and attacker techniques
Expertise with EDR platforms and advanced endpoint analysis
Expert-level understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework
Experience with threat intelligence frameworks (Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain)
Advanced network packet analysis skills (Wireshark, tcpdump)
Ability to analyze malicious scripts, PowerShell commands, and malware behavior
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple complex investigations
Ability to obtain and maintain US Secret clearance (US citizenship required)

Additional Requirements For Information Security Staff IV

5-7 years in security operations, threat analysis, incident response, or SOC environments
5+ years in cyber threat intelligence analysis, production, and program management

How You Can Stand Out

Certifications: GCTI, CTIA, GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GMON, CySA+, CISSP, etc.
Prior experience as CTI Lead, Manager, or Program Owner
Government, military, or defense intelligence background with formal training
Experience developing intelligence requirements and collection strategies
Advanced proficiency with ThreatConnect, Anomali, MISP, Recorded Future
OSINT research, dark web monitoring, and underground forum analysis experience
Malware analysis and reverse engineering skills
Published threat intelligence research or conference presentations
Scripting proficiency (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and analysis
Experience with SOAR platforms
Cloud security operations experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Experience in classified or high-security environments
Network security monitoring tools experience (Zeek, Suricata, Snort)
Red team/purple team exercise participation
Analyst mentoring and training experience
Knowledge of compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, 800-171, CMMC)
Familiarity with IC standards (ICD 203, ICD 206)

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$107,000.00 - $160,500.00

Pay Basis: Annual

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

Operate Strategically
Lead Change  
Engage with Impact  
Foster Innovation  
Deliver Results

Ways We Reward Our Employees

During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

Comprehensive health care and wellness plans
Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation
Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options
401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire
Flexible spending accounts
Variable pay program for exceptional contributions
Relocation assistance
Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career
Education assistance programs
An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . You can also review Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager I
new_jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About The Role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What You’ll Do

Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What We Look For

8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Overview

A leader in cutting-edge research and technology in the cyber arena, CPMG focuses on using business drivers to guide cybersecurity activities and manage risk. CPMG offers flexible, integrative solutions for Department of Defense (DoD) contractors, among others, and specializes in cybersecurity, information and operational technology, electronic security surveillance, and support services.

Summary:

The Data Analyst - Journeyman (JNY) is responsible for analyzing structured and unstructured data to support decision-making across USSOCOM. This role involves working with data sets from various sources to develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that help leadership and operational teams gain actionable insights. The analyst will collaborate with database administrators, system engineers, and mission stakeholders to deliver high-quality, data-driven visualization solutions in support of SOCOM’s mission.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience working with data tools and visualization platforms. This position requires familiarity with databases, data modeling, business intelligence.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Collecting, cleaning, transforming, and analyzing large data sets from multiple sources to identify trends and support decision-making.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or other data integration platforms.
Working closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and design user-friendly reports and data visualizations.
Writing queries and scripts to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from enterprise databases.
Supporting the generation of recurring and ad hoc reports for operational and leadership teams.
Contributing to the design and implementation of data models and workflows that enhance reporting efficiency.
Conducting data quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting outputs.
Documenting data sources, processes, and report specifications for continuity and audit readiness.
Collaborating with IT teams and database administrators to troubleshoot data access and integration issues.
Providing analytical support for strategic initiatives, operational planning, and mission readiness assessments.
Ensuring compliance with USSOCOM data governance, classification, and cybersecurity standards.
Presenting findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mentor junior team members by reviewing analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to USSOCOM data governance standards, and fostering technical skill development.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

Experience in data modeling, transformation, and visualization.
Familiarity with SQL and experience writing queries for data extraction and analysis.
Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or .NET).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and Access.
Ability to develop data visualizations that inform leadership decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

High school diploma with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience, 4 years’ experience with Associate's, OR 2 years’ experience with Bachelor's.
Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 422 - Data Analyst- Intermediate level or higher.
Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI clearance or higher is required.
Ability to successfully pass a background check

Responsibilities

Custom Team Responsibilities

Issue vote document recommendations to clients pursuant to respective voting policies while utilizing expertise on corporate governance issues and gathering data based on information in the company’s public disclosure.
Perform research on a variety of proposals to be voted on at annual shareholder meetings of publicly traded companies from a client-specific perspective.
Develop and update client proxy voting guidelines. Update and utilize expertise in market practices/trends and apply extensive knowledge about each client’s proxy voting and corporate governance policies. Identify policy gaps and outdated approaches in clients’ policies.
Consult with International/US research analysts on any topical or controversial issues.
Analyze historical client trends to suggest options on policy positions.
Contribute to seasonal reviews and client-focused research reports.
Research issues of interests to the clients and provide additional information related to the company’s corporate governance practices.

Work with tech to generate fixes to the applications to enable faster and accurate production of research.
Participate in company-wide programs, and work with other team/department members for policy-related issues.

#RESEARCH

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Company

Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Supply Chain Program Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.

You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub-components
Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
Dual-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain

Supplier Relationship Management

Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts
Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics
Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules
Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

New Product Introduction: Partner with R&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability
Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime
Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end-to-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks

Requirements

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field
8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries
Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards)
Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations
Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena)
Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high-tech industries
Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long-term contracts in volatile markets.
Experience developing and executing successful, long-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components
Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning
Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

Other Requirements

This is a full-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office
Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%)

Benefits

Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
Free Food & Snacks
Stock Option Plan
Annual Bonus Plan eligible
Short Term & Long Term Disability
Base Salary: $140,000 - $160,000

Additional Information

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager I
new_jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About The Role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What You’ll Do

Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What We Look For

8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.
Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000 - $188,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

new_jobs.title: Internal Audit Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.
Position Overview

The Internal Audit Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of internal audit projects across the organization. The Project Manager ensures audit engagements are performed according to the International Professional Practices Global Internal Audit Standards published by the Institute of Internal Auditors. The Project Manager plays a key role in identifying and assessing business risks, ensuring audit quality, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and integrity.
The Internal Audit Project Manager will report to the Deputy Head of Internal Audit
Key Responsibilities

Audit Planning & Leadership
Together with the Deputy Head of Internal Audit, lead the audit planning (including timeline and deadline definition), scope and resource allocation for audit engagements, ensuring alignment with objectives.
Supervise audit teams, providing direction, technical guidance, and coaching throughout the engagement.
Identify key business risks and ensure appropriate audit scoping for the audits under its direct management
Audit Execution & Quality Management
Oversee and ensure the execution of audits in accordance with IIA Global Internal Audit Standards and internal methodologies. It may do so under the leadership of the Deputy Head of Internal Audit or the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management.
Review workpapers, test results, and reports to guarantee consistency, accuracy, and professional standards.
Apply data analytics and digital audit tools to enhance audit efficiency and insight generation and risk detection whenever possible.
Monitor Internal Audit progress, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure deadlines are met.
For certain audits, may also lead the engagement from planning to execution and reporting under the leadership of the Deputy Head of Internal Audit
Stakeholder Engagement & Reporting
Prepare, review and present comprehensive audit reports that clearly communicate findings, risks, with appropriate management action plans.
Serve as a trusted business partner and advisor to management, fostering strong relationships across departments and geographies.
Communicate key audit findings, trends, and insights to senior management
Perform or oversee the Management Action Plan implementation follow-up, ensure timeline closure of internal audit actions
Continuous Improvement & Team Development
Contribute to the evolution of audit methodologies, templates, and digital tools.
Mentor, coach, and develop internal audit staff, promoting a culture of learning and excellence
Stay current with regulatory developments, risk trends, and the Global Internal Audit Standards

You will bring:

At least 8 years of proven experience in internal or external auditing, preferably within an industrial company
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, risk management, and governance principles.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and provide strategic recommendations.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Professional certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) are an asset.
Fluency in English

You will get:

The Portuguese annual base salary reasonably expected to be paid for this new hire is €48,400 to €60,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualification and internal equity and can ultimately be more or less than the posted salary range.
Benefits package
16, or more, weeks of maternity/paternity and co-parenting leave, according to local regulations
Training platform for all employees
Free well-being sessions (physical and psychological)

Additional information:

Location: Portugal, Lisbon
Hybrid working model
Travelling up to 20%

About Us

Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity.
At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. We encourage individuals who may require any assistance or accommodations to let us know to ensure a seamless application experience. We are here to support you throughout the application journey and want to ensure all candidates are treated equally. If you are unsure whether you meet all the criteria or qualifications listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

new_jobs.title: Operations Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before?

How We Started

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where We Are Now

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where We’re Going

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

The Opportunity

The Ops Data Analyst role delivers accurate, timely and reliable insight across operational domains, including Clinical Operations, Medical, Customer Support and Physical Operations.

This role has a particular focus on physical and operational performance, including dispatch, SLA adherence, workflow volumes, supply chain management and fulfilment metrics, while also able to support the other areas of Ops analytics where required.

The Analyst works closely with physical operational stakeholders and is expected to independently manage medium-complexity analysis, escalating more ambiguous or high-risk investigations where appropriate.

What You’ll Do

Cross-Operational Reporting & Insight Delivery

Provide analytical support across core operational workflows, with a focus on physical operations:

Dispatch performance, SLA adherence, and fulfilment efficiency
Stock & work force management staff level reporting
Operational drivers impacting service levels
Consultation volumes and approval or rejection rates
Customer support performance metrics and workflow trends
Build and maintain dashboards that provide clear, structured visibility of operational performance.
Identify trends and drivers within operational datasets and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Support & Structured Analysis

Translate stakeholder questions into structured analytical approaches
Deliver medium-complexity analyses end-to-end
Support deeper or higher-risk investigations in collaboration with Senior Analysts
Analyse SLA adherence and operational performance metrics
Ensure outputs are commercially and operationally relevant

Data Quality & Governance

Own QA of analytical outputs
Contribute towards clear documentation and data governance topics
Understand data lineage across operational systems
Identify and flag upstream data or tracking issues
Follow established QA and governance standards

Experience

What you’ll bring to HeliosX

2–4 years’ experience in analytics or business intelligence
Experience analysing operational performance data
Understanding of metrics such as dispatch rate, SLAs, workflow volumes, and conversion funnels
Experience working with multiple data sources
Experience in fast paced network environments

Skills

Able to write basic SQL & understands SQL fundamentals to be able to validate independently
Cleans and transforms data from multiple sources
Builds complex reporting and dashboards
Experience with spreadsheeting tools
Experience of using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (Sage advantageous)
Use & experience of using WHS/WMS software e.g. blue yonder etc.
Experience with BI and visualisation tools
Ability to translate business questions into structured analytical approaches
Identifies trends and key drivers within datasets
Presents clear and concise insights
Project & stakeholder management handling and documenting multiple tasks (Jira & Sprint experience advantageous)

Life at HeliosX

At HeliosX, we’re building the future of healthcare. That means we need brilliant, mission-driven people who are excited to innovate, scale, and create change.

Here’s What You Can Expect

25 Days Holiday (+ public holidays)
Private healthcare, including dental and vision cover
Employee Pension with Smart Pension and enhanced parental leave
Cycle-to-work and Electric Car schemes
Free monthly products from Dermatica and MedExpress, plus family discounts
Home office allowance
Wellbeing perks: Headspace subscription, gym discounts, L&D budget, and free Audible subscription

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 Organizations Worldwide Rely On SHI’s Concierge Approach To Help Them Solve What’s Next. But The Heartbeat Of SHI Is Our Employees – All 7,000 Of Them. If You Join Our Team, You’ll Enjoy

Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.
Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.
Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.
World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Operations Analyst will assist with vendor management and customer billing by working closely with the internal Project Management teams, Technical Account Management teams, Services Accounting, and SHI’s subcontractor network. They will work to improve processes, ensure process consistency, and ensure service projects are billed accurately and on time. The Analyst will also extract, analyze, and process billing data to generate customer invoices.

This position will report to a Manager within the PMO. This position is required to report to the Austin, TX office location as determined by SHI management. 

Role Description

Manage and process billing and invoicing, ensuring accuracy from subcontractor to customer.
Coordinate with internal and external teams to resolve billing issues and provide status updates.
Analyze and audit billing data to generate and process invoices accurately.
Act as a subject matter expert for billing and invoicing processes.
Develop and document process improvements to enhance efficiency.
Create reports and dashboards to monitor business health and future trends.
Communicate processes and act as a liaison between operations and other teams.
Define and manage business and technical requirements for projects.
Coordinate and manage projects from discovery to completion, providing updates to stakeholders.
Collaborate with stakeholders to implement system changes and improvements.

Behaviors and Competencies

Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.
Detail-Oriented: Can identify errors or inconsistencies in work and make necessary corrections.
Organization: Can prioritize daily tasks, manage personal workflow, and utilize basic tools to keep track of responsibilities.
Prioritization: Can identify critical tasks, arrange them based on importance, and execute without explicit instructions.
Multi-Tasking: Can identify opportunities for task optimization, propose solutions, and manage multiple tasks without explicit instructions.
Follow-Through: Can manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines without needing explicit reminders.
Continuous Improvement: Can identify moderate areas for improvement and implement moderate changes.
Data Analysis: Can identify patterns and trends in data, propose hypotheses, and use statistical techniques to test them.
Problem-Solving: Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action to resolve them without explicit instructions.
Collaboration: Can actively participate in team discussions, respect differing opinions, and collaborate with others to achieve common goals.

Skill Level Requirements

The ability to effectively utilize applications like Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook to enhance productivity and perform various tasks efficiently. - Basic
Proficient in utilizing Microsoft Excel for data analysis, including the use of formulas, functions, pivot tables, and data visualization tools. - Basic
Knowledge of various project management frameworks such as Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum, to effectively plan, execute, and close projects. - Basic
Competence in utilizing tools like Jira, Trello, MS Project, or DevOps to plan, track, and manage project progress and resources. - Basic

Other Requirements

Completed Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or relevant work experience required
2+ years of professional experience in Managed Services billing or Project Management/Coordination
1-3 years of experience in data analysis, IT operations, and/or project management
1-3 years of professional experience working with Microsoft Office applications
Ability to travel 10%

Autotask by Datto
Airtable
Database Applicatinos
Billing Software
Microsoft SharePoint

new_jobs.description:
DATA ANALYST

About R/Ga And This Role

R/GA designs intelligent brand systems that help businesses get ahead.

The Data practice gives those systems their intelligence and proves we get brands ahead.

Reporting will always be part of the job. But our work is changing rapidly towards building the systems and solutions that help brands decide and act.

This role sits at the centre of that shift. A measurement framework can become a test-and-learn programme. A dashboard can become an always-on intelligence solution across multiple surfaces. Repeated manual analysis can become an automated pipeline. Your job is to deliver what is needed now and spot what it should become next.

On Any Given Day You Might

Develop measurement frameworks aligned to business goals & strategy.
Present performance results to a client and give them one clear recommendation, not five hedged options.
Implement, test and debug analytics tracking on a client's site or app.
Build and ship a working AI pipeline from a clear spec. Prompts, evaluation, data in and out, documented so a peer can run it.
Pull data from BigQuery, GA4, media platforms or a CRM and work out what it is actually saying.
Build a dashboard that a client opens every Monday and trusts. Then ask what it would take to make the dashboard unnecessary.
Take a reporting task you were handed and come back with the thing it should have been.
Write the spec for the next thing we build.

What We Expect From You On Day One

We are hiring for someone who already builds with AI because they cannot help themselves, who finds marketing data interesting, and who wants to learn from the team, the strategists, designers and technologists sitting next to them.

You have built something with AI. A side project, a university assignment, a work tool or a weekend experiment. You have written prompts that failed, fixed them and shipped something another person used. You can show us what you built, explain how you tested it and tell us what you would improve.
You care about AI beyond the hype. You read the model release notes. You experiment with new tools. You have opinions about where this is going and want to spend the next few years getting very good at applying it.
You find marketing fascinating. Media performance, website analytics, CRM, loyalty, brand health and search. You understand that these are connected systems that influence whether a brand grows, and you want to know how they work together.
You use numbers to change what happens next. A finding nobody acts on is a finding you have not finished. You care more about the decision the data drives than the chart it sits in, and you will push until someone does something differently because of what you found.

You Bring

Experience building with large language models. Prompt design, retrieval, evaluation, tool use or multi-step pipelines. Professional, academic or self-taught all count.
Experience taking data end-to-end from analysis and insight development through to clear, compelling presentations for senior and executive stakeholders. You can turn complex findings into a story that supports a decision.
Working Python and SQL knowledge. You can read, write and debug both.
Hands-on time with messy real-world data. You can join it, clean it, structure it, and spot a wrong number before anyone tells you.
Familiarity with at least two of: GA4 or Google Tag Manager, BigQuery, Looker Studio or Power BI, Adobe Analytics, a media platform (Meta, Google Ads, DV360), a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze).

Why R/Ga

At R/GA, how we work is as important as what we build. Regardless of title, every team member brings these Signature Behaviours to life.

Make Things Happen
— Ownership, momentum, and adaptability.

Make Things Together
— Cross-functional collaboration, openness to feedback, and building on shared ideas.

Make Things New
— Experimentation, fresh perspectives, and questioning the default.

Make Things Matter

Interested in joining one of Canada’s top-performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst
for an existing vacancy in our Investment Data Architecture (IDArch)
team. Our team resides within the middle office and enables the organization to get more value from its investment data. We lead Modern Data Platform (MDP) enablement for the investment data domain, set the standards and governance that help business teams own and build trusted data products, and act as primary owners of the Investment Data Management platform, including security master, pricing master, and market reference data. We place high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and influence are growing enterprise-wide. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do

Partner with investment and operations stakeholders to understand their data needs, and translate them into clear business requirements, data definitions, business rules, and acceptance criteria for the technical team. 
Support business data owners in defining and preparing trusted, reusable investment datasets (data products) through intake, definition and readiness using agreed standards, and contribute to ongoing stewardship and lifecycle reviews.
Develop conceptual and logical investment data models with business owners and technical partners and explain them clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Collaborate with data engineers and business teams to define and validate business transformation rules and source-to-target mappings and confirm that delivered data meets business expectations. 
Work with data owners and stewards to define data quality rules and critical data elements and analyze data-quality exceptions and reconciliation breaks. 
Act as a subject-matter resource on security master, pricing, holdings and reference data across equity, fixed income, and derivatives, ensuring consistency across systems. 
Document data models, mappings, data flows and business processes, and contribute business glossary terms, data definitions and lineage information to support transparency and governance. 
Contribute to strategic data projects – including requirements, testing, and release validation – in collaboration with operations, engineering, and senior management. 
Identify opportunities to improve investment data usability, consistency and operational efficiency. 

What You Bring

A degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Analysis, or a related field. Progress toward a designation such as the CFA or FRM is an asset. 
3–5 years of experience in investment management or financial services, ideally in investment data management, investment operations, or business analysis. Hands-on knowledge of equity, fixed income, or derivative data is required; experience with security master, pricing, or an Enterprise Data Management (EDM) platform is a plus. 
Proven ability to elicit requirements, run working sessions, and turn ambiguous business needs into clear, documented requirements and acceptance criteria. 
SQL is an asset; familiarity with Python, PySpark, Lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric or similar data platforms is a plus. 
Exposure to conceptual or logical data modeling, or experience defining data entities, relationships and business rules, is an asset.
Understanding of data quality, data ownership, data governance and metadata concepts.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to business users and business needs to technical teams. 
A curious, detail-oriented self-starter who takes initiative and delivers outcomes with measurable results.

The expected base salary range for this position is $85,000–$120,000. The midpoint represents our general market target for a fully qualified and experienced individual performing the role. estarás en una posición técnico-operativa enfocada en la ejecución cotidiana de proyectos de visualización de datos, preparación de fuentes de información de medios digitales y soporte a marcos de medición. Es una posición ideal para un profesional en desarrollo que busca consolidar sus habilidades en Business Intelligence aplicado al Marketing Digital ( Investment Analytics ).

Responsabilidades

Desarrollo de Reportes con Enfoque Visual: Diseñar, construir y actualizar dashboards en Tableau, Power BI o Looker Studio, aplicando nociones básicas de Data Storytelling para estructurar la información de forma lógica, clara y limpia.
